lessons_before.title: Test linear-quadratic ambient output extensions using filtered quadric rings before attempting fibre rectification
lessons_before.when: A genuine stable hypersurface embedding carries a plane Keller output pair through an ambient linear and nondegenerate quadratic observable, or a direct native A/B encoding is proposed.
lessons_before.use: Normalize the two inverse-metric normal types. A monic hyperbolic relation gives a free normal-monomial basis and an additive degree filtration over the generic field and each height-one residue field. Generic factoriality follows from elimination in the isotropic type and a prime-coordinate Laurent localization with Nagata criterion in the nonisotropic type. Disjoint generic affine-space components then form a Galois-descended pencil. Primitive coefficient valuations clear denominators globally; smoothness and DK invertibility force the label-relation derivative constant and degree one. The plane Keller base is invertible. This extends the coordinate-pair obstruction without rectifying any quadric embedding. HC4MYHR0/1 now test relative critical sections and curve products and classify every base-only quadratic graph under unrestricted relative free-variable automorphisms, without alignment and with at most one full critical point under unit Hessian. HC4MYHS0/1/2 add a one-component proper-Morse closure and exact universal JC2 boundaries for the two separate conditions, with an explicit arbitrary-dimensional finite-free monomial-basis construction. HC4MYHT0/1 add uniform quadratic-plane rigidity and the entire fibre-affine two-affine embedding classification, with alignment forced and all base matrix degrees unrestricted. HC4MYHU0/1 now rectify isotropic-ideal image graphs explicitly and classify every compatible positive-weight invariant image into the singleton orbit or a degenerate critical-point obstruction, without assuming equivariance in actual source coordinates. HC4MYHV0/1 now test arbitrary-degree ambient output observables by a global filtered criterion and a smooth scheme-theoretic complete intersection at infinity, with the Picard input explicit. HC4MYHW0/1 replace factoriality by torsion-free abelian divisor-class monodromy and replace height-one graded domains by geometrically integral affine fibres; HC4MYHW2/3 close r=1 quadric pairs, specified degenerate ranks and all cyclic Danielewski powers. HC4MYHX0/1 preserve arbitrary finite monodromy descending from a regular polynomial parameter; HC4MYHX2 closes all constant-coefficient Danielewski P(z) and every T*Y+xy-B(T,z) suspension in every degree, beyond the earlier abelian class-action gate. HC4MYHY0/1 now close normal finite monogenic root covers and every monic two-parameter Danielewski output by root transitivity; HC4MYHY2 imposes a global nonmonogenicity gate on every nontrivial finite Keller normalization. HC4MYHZ0/1/2 supply the finite leading-fibre gate and independent abelian-root gate for nonmonic outputs, with exact localized-unit defect. HC4MYIA0/1/2 upgrade the unconditional nonmonic gate to finite nilpotent root/class groups and arbitrary common-prime radical depth. HC4MYIB0/1/2 add arbitrary Galois-intermediate exclusion, the exact global normalization-boundary basis, and subnormal class-stabilizer closure beyond nilpotent actions. HC4MYIC0/1/2 add combined leading-order factor divisibility, rational-label critical-curve geometry and new unrestricted-parameter S3 cubic closures. HC4MYID0/1 refine critical units to factor-specific supports and all subset rank budgets, closing a new square-discriminant S3 family with arbitrary leading multiplicity. HC4MYID2 closes reduced singleton critical units with nonconstant separation, including the cubic two-simple-leading-level case. HC4MYID3 closes the fixed cubic by a polynomial second chart omitting a hyperbola and consequently the entire specified two-simple-level square-critical class. HC4MYIE0/1/2 supply the intermediate-pole necessity, cyclic derivative surface, normal monic rescaling and unrestricted square-free-leading cubic closure. HC4MYIF0/1/2 constrain every source factorization, close square-free-leading quartics and supply a field-degree and nonnormal-order obstruction for the remaining unequal pair. HC4MYIG0/1/2 add reduced-pencil rational monodromy, one-exception polynomial parameters and all-degree scaled and reciprocal-scaled one-variable output closures. The same mechanism now closes rational scalings and rational affine input with polynomial output translation, including all sparse two-positive-term outputs without a gcd condition. HC4MYIH0/1/2 add the strict projective multiplicity bound, exact affine-in-V exception certificate and all-degree mixed-critical-value expansion outputs. HC4MYII0/1/2/3/4 add plane intermediate-branch geometry, unrestricted rational affine parameters, actual-inertia quotient certificates, all nonadjacent pure-power binomials and every cubic output. HC4MYIJ0/1/2/3 add relative central-series descent, actual product-cover preservation with arbitrary parameter monodromy, and the all-degree finite-critical-pole binomial certificate. HC4MYIK0/1/2/3 add parameter-cover unit norms, integral algebraic monic models, a direct critical-value valuation lemma and unrestricted plane polynomial-output closure. HC4MYIL0/1/2 add generative factor transfer, exact fixed-multiplier class lattices and all-degree multivariable suspension closure with full global filtration. HC4MYIM0/1/2/3 add parameter-extension irreducibility, moving-row invariant vanishing, an exact content-fibre criterion and uniform adapted global frames. The IM3 determinant-one parameter matrix covers moving B, multivariable monic-leading b and arbitrary affine root terms, with a separate primitive-content check. The IM3 frame admits every strict joint degree-gap remainder; its univariate leading-divisibility corollary allows all lower P coefficients. HC4MYIN0/1 replace the former global-frame requirement by rank-two reflexive pencil descent and close every primitive disjoint moving suspension. HC4MYIO0/1/2 extend to arbitrary independent coefficient fields and overlapping polynomial directions; monic and polynomial-Bezout leading overlap outputs have uniform generic filtrations. HC4MYIP0/1/2 use moved relative additive actions instead of positive generic filtrations, and force every surviving overlap image into the multiplier-variable invariant subring. HC4MYIQ0/1/2 descend any univariate generic helper, close every one-helper admitted overlap including nonprimitive content, and reduce HC4 survivors to two-helper invariant plane curves. HC4MYIR0/1/2 close multiplier-zero images in all helper counts and every admitted two-helper overlap in every stable dimension; the complete admitted HC4 overlap family is now closed. IS0/1/2 identify the full JC2 content of an unconditional residual-free extension, including an exact source-correlated class lattice and actual unit-Hessian embeddings with an always invertible constructed gradient. IT0/1/2 give intrinsic finite-energy and inverse-Hessian certificates and a mixed three-direction criterion before any ambient output construction. IU0/1/2 exploit actual free projections and the zero-section first jet, closing critical-value traces and testing the global immersion obligation in a universal noncritical construction. IV0/1/2 separate complete compensation identities from codimension-one source recovery and provide a canonical Legendre-hypersurface normality gate. IW0/1/2 close every constant trace through an infinite-order integral middle-cycle obstruction, with arbitrary helper degrees. IX0/1/2 separate arbitrary quadric plane classes from actual radical-curve recovery and close coordinate-composite or smooth/nonparametric descended nonconstant traces. IY0/1/2 close contractible full-preimage curves and descended cusps, and impose the exact generic-pencil boundary-defect certificate on the remaining multibranch cases. IZ0/1/2 match the intrinsic generic genus on all one-place zero curves and close every rank-one descended trace, including all internally multibranch cases and positive-power rational descent. JA0/1/2 force the actual disjoint extra-prime/unit/boundary configuration and bound its one-place part; scalar extra units close the selected one-place case.
lessons_before.avoid: Using generic factoriality without the global primitive step; treating the quadratic observable as an ambient coordinate; extending surface-quadric factoriality to r=1; dropping closed embedding; assuming the quadratic observable equals the HC4 potential; using nonlinear source Hessian invariance.
lessons_before.boundary: The theorem covers all polynomial embedding degrees and all stable dimensions r>=2, both inverse-metric normal types and arbitrary ambient changes carrying the output pair to that form. Arbitrary output-pair extensions, unaligned two-affine embeddings and both plane endpoints remain open. Direct native A/B encodings give only the coordinate/unit-ideal source-orbit endpoint after the stipulated Keller base is forced invertible. Relative critical schemes now give a separate global gate. A polynomial section over a constant two-variable base, or a base-compatible smooth curve times A1 with vertical Hessian rank one, forces gradient invertibility under unit Hessian. Consequently every base-only normal graph j=(s,t,h(s,t),H,G) under arbitrary relative free-variable polynomial automorphisms has at most one full critical point under unit Hessian, with no cotangent alignment. Its nonautomorphic members are exactly the two old endpoint source orbits. Native graph members with multiple full critical points have no relative unitization over that fixed base. Arbitrary four-variable source mixing and three genuinely free-dependent unretained coordinates remain open. One proper relative Morse component now suffices: no condition on other components is needed, and a globally proper everywhere-Morse relative projection can only have degree one. Each nonautomorphic component must therefore fail properness or contain vertical degeneracy. However each single condition separately retains exactly JC2. The universal f_M model has relative projection K and vertical Hessian -DK^T*DK, while the finite-free Fermat construction gives every K a proper relative projection with explicit monomial basis and ramification at zero. Its properness is not properness of K. Neither model automatically supplies a compatible closed ambient embedding. The two plane endpoints and unrestricted graph compatibility remain open. Uniform quadratic two-planes now have the same unique-plane rigidity under nonautomorphy as affine ones: any genuinely quadratic constant two-plane or two distinct quadratic planes closes the candidate. This classifies every fibre-affine two-affine embedding j=(s,t,b+A*w) in all base degrees. Global source generation requires a polynomial left inverse of A; generic rank is not enough. Alignment follows under nonautomorphy, a rank-three helper quadratic closes unconditionally, and lower ranks force a base-only helper and the two old endpoints. All unit-Hessian members have at most one full critical point. Arbitrary nonlinear free helpers and nonaligned potentials of free degree at least three remain open. Nonlinear isotropic-ideal image graphs now have explicit global quadratic isometries to hyperplanes, with arbitrary coefficients in unchanged variables and all source parameterizations. Compatible positive linear ambient weights give a constructive recognition gate: a smooth invariant image either has an isotropic tangent normal forbidding unit Hessian, or its lower-weight nonlinear terms admit a weighted Euler shear to the nonisotropic hyperplane. Only the singleton-zero endpoint survives for these positive images. Actual positive linear source weights would close gradient invertibility, but image invariance alone does not supply that hypothesis after nonlinear source changes. Other nonlinear images and both plane endpoints remain open. The output-base gate now admits arbitrary degrees for both ambient observables: a smooth scheme-theoretic codimension-two complete intersection of their highest forms at infinity forces any carried Keller pair invertible. The leading regular sequence supplies a common filtered basis and height-one graded domains, while the explicitly imported smooth complete-intersection Picard theorem supplies generic factoriality. Generic factoriality alone and smooth reduced support do not suffice; Pi=(x,xy+z^2) has an exact denominator failure. Arbitrary extensions need not have the required leading forms. Singular, nonreduced or excess-dimensional infinity intersections and both plane endpoints remain open. Generic factoriality is now relaxed by HC4MYHW0/1: torsion-free abelian divisor-class monodromy suffices, since Keller function fields contain no nontrivial abelian Galois intermediate field and all conjugate component classes then become zero. Geometric integrality of affine height-one fibres suffices for global primitive saturation even with nonconstant fibre units or reducible graded rings. The earlier r=1 exclusion for nondegenerate linear-quadratic output pairs is removed by HC4MYHW2, without calling the quadric surface factorial; degenerate restricted-rank-at-least-three quadratics close too. HC4MYHW3 closes cyclic Danielewski output pairs in every power m>=2, including nonreduced ordinary leading schemes and generic nonfactoriality outside every older smooth-infinity frame in the HC4-size first type. Nonabelian class actions, torsion, nonintegral height-one fibres, uncovered ranks and infinity schemes and both plane endpoints remain open. The nonabelian boundary is now narrower: HC4MYHX0/1 prove that a nowhere-critical polynomial parameter is relatively algebraically closed in the source field, using an explicit classical closed-polynomial import. A class action descending from a finite cover of that one parameter retains its full possibly nonabelian group under Keller base change, so the component classes become principal. This does not make all special parameter fibres irreducible or the whole Keller extension trivial. HC4MYHX2 closes every constant-coefficient nonconstant Danielewski P(z), with arbitrary root group, and every suspended T*Y+xy-B(T,z) with arbitrary two-variable B and all degrees. The earlier nonabelian-P(z) and suspended-coefficient escape proposals are retired. Genuinely two-parameter unsuspended monodromy, torsion, nonintegral height-one fibres, other missing filtrations and both plane endpoints remain open. HC4MYHY0 now preserves irreducibility of every normal finite monogenic cover under Keller base change, in every dimension and degree. All conjugate constant cross-resultants and integral roots rule out inertia crossing; explicit purity and finite-cover comparison inputs make the quotient trivial. HC4MYHY1 closes every two-parameter P(T,z) with nonzero constant leading z coefficient: root transitivity, without full splitting-group preservation, makes the invariant root-divisor classes zero. HC4MYHY2 forbids a globally monogenic finite normalization for any nontrivial Keller intermediate field; a nonautomorphic plane normalization needs at least two additional global algebra generators. Generic primitive elements do not provide normal monogenic models. Nonconstant leading coefficients, nonnormal monic presentations, nonglobally-monogenic normal finite algebras, other embeddings and both plane endpoints remain open. HC4MYHZ0 computes the exact torsion-free localized-unit defect as the sum of the reduced full-fibre component lattices at the zeros of a(T). HC4MYHZ1 preserves normal monogenic root-cover irreducibility on that vertical open when just those finitely many full K1-fibres are irreducible. The remaining finite etale generic-affine-line quotient is a finite Galois parameter extension, eliminated using HC4MYHX0; the explicitly imported Riemann-Hurwitz formula proves the constant-field descent. HC4MYHZ2 consequently closes every nonmonic P(T,z) under that finite-fibre gate. Independently, abelian generic root monodromy closes all such P without the fibre hypothesis, including every z degree one or two and arbitrary translated powers a(T)*(z-b(T))^m+c(T). A remaining nonautomorphic realization in this family needs both nonabelian generic root monodromy and positive localized-unit defect at a leading-coefficient zero. lessons_before.title: Use nonzero rank1 Morse leading terms and ordered growth before attempting a full formal decomposition
lessons_before.when: A flat cut basis has controlled tails and some or all critical contributions have a verified nonzero scalar Morse leading amplitude.
lessons_before.use: For the nodal critical-line triangle, separate its two off-axis rank1 actions into distinct positive growth rates while the five line contributions decay. For finite-critical profiles, turn pointwise coercivity into polynomial parameter bounds by semialgebraic cell selection, construct jointly polynomial cut carriers and use logarithmic cutoffs to match actual full-cut Morse asymptotics. Check positive-action differences, not only point distinctness. Remove growing coefficients successively; bounded Morse and negative-action contributions then decay.
lessons_before.avoid: Inferring nonzero leading scalar amplitudes from a point count, using only the local Hessian without checking higher terms after escape rescaling, imposing genericity on a closed discriminant boundary by continuity, equating distinct saddles with distinct positive actions, or using a general Fourier/direct-image theorem without identifying the source module and infinity contribution. On the quartic escape profile, compute gamma=d*e*m/(2*c)-l_T and retain gamma=0. Use one common coefficient field when reducing action identities.

lessons_before.reopen_when: Multiple local Milnor blocks or equal positive actions must be grouped, the quartic gamma=0 chart is analyzed, a different leading singularity is introduced, or an effective numerical pure gate is requested. lessons_before.title: Use relative critical schemes to classify base-only graph reparameterizations without assuming the intrinsic plane aligned
lessons_before.when: Two affine source base coordinates are retained and a relative critical section or rank-one curve product is available, especially a normal graph j=(s,t,h(s,t),H,G).
lessons_before.use: Exhaust the rank of Tang plane over the retained base. A relative section yields a polynomial binary envelope with unit Hessian; known HC2 forces an inverse. A rank-one critical curve product gives actual quotient-plane coordinates and a Keller syzygy whose curvature coefficient forces the curve to be straight. Apply these criteria to all constant quadratic ranks in the two free ambient directions. The remaining isotropic case is controlled by the constant relative orientation at coefficient zeros. All unit-Hessian members of the base-only graph family have at most one full critical point, and nonautomorphic members retain exactly the two old endpoints. HC4MYHS0/1/2 add a one-component proper-Morse closure and exact universal JC2 boundaries for the two separate conditions, with an explicit arbitrary-dimensional finite-free monomial-basis construction. HC4MYHT0/1 add uniform quadratic-plane rigidity and the entire fibre-affine two-affine embedding classification, with alignment forced and all base matrix degrees unrestricted. HC4MYHU0/1 now rectify isotropic-ideal image graphs explicitly and classify every compatible positive-weight invariant image into the singleton orbit or a degenerate critical-point obstruction, without assuming equivariance in actual source coordinates. HC4MYHV0/1 now test arbitrary-degree ambient output observables by a global filtered criterion and a smooth scheme-theoretic complete intersection at infinity, with the Picard input explicit. HC4MYHW0/1 replace factoriality by torsion-free abelian divisor-class monodromy and replace height-one graded domains by geometrically integral affine fibres; HC4MYHW2/3 close r=1 quadric pairs, specified degenerate ranks and all cyclic Danielewski powers. HC4MYHX0/1 preserve arbitrary finite monodromy descending from a regular polynomial parameter; HC4MYHX2 closes all constant-coefficient Danielewski P(z) and every T*Y+xy-B(T,z) suspension in every degree, beyond the earlier abelian class-action gate. HC4MYHY0/1 now close normal finite monogenic root covers and every monic two-parameter Danielewski output by root transitivity; HC4MYHY2 imposes a global nonmonogenicity gate on every nontrivial finite Keller normalization. HC4MYHZ0/1/2 supply the finite leading-fibre gate and independent abelian-root gate for nonmonic outputs, with exact localized-unit defect. HC4MYIA0/1/2 upgrade the unconditional nonmonic gate to finite nilpotent root/class groups and arbitrary common-prime radical depth. HC4MYIB0/1/2 add arbitrary Galois-intermediate exclusion, the exact global normalization-boundary basis, and subnormal class-stabilizer closure beyond nilpotent actions. HC4MYIC0/1/2 add combined leading-order factor divisibility, rational-label critical-curve geometry and new unrestricted-parameter S3 cubic closures. HC4MYID0/1 refine critical units to factor-specific supports and all subset rank budgets, closing a new square-discriminant S3 family with arbitrary leading multiplicity. HC4MYID2 closes reduced singleton critical units with nonconstant separation, including the cubic two-simple-leading-level case. HC4MYID3 closes the fixed cubic by a polynomial second chart omitting a hyperbola and consequently the entire specified two-simple-level square-critical class. HC4MYIE0/1/2 supply the intermediate-pole necessity, cyclic derivative surface, normal monic rescaling and unrestricted square-free-leading cubic closure. HC4MYIF0/1/2 constrain every source factorization, close square-free-leading quartics and supply a field-degree and nonnormal-order obstruction for the remaining unequal pair. HC4MYIG0/1/2 add reduced-pencil rational monodromy, one-exception polynomial parameters and all-degree scaled and reciprocal-scaled one-variable output closures. The same mechanism now closes rational scalings and rational affine input with polynomial output translation, including all sparse two-positive-term outputs without a gcd condition. HC4MYIH0/1/2 add the strict projective multiplicity bound, exact affine-in-V exception certificate and all-degree mixed-critical-value expansion outputs. HC4MYII0/1/2/3/4 add plane intermediate-branch geometry, unrestricted rational affine parameters, actual-inertia quotient certificates, all nonadjacent pure-power binomials and every cubic output. HC4MYIJ0/1/2/3 add relative central-series descent, actual product-cover preservation with arbitrary parameter monodromy, and the all-degree finite-critical-pole binomial certificate. HC4MYIK0/1/2/3 add parameter-cover unit norms, integral algebraic monic models, a direct critical-value valuation lemma and unrestricted plane polynomial-output closure. HC4MYIL0/1/2 add generative factor transfer, exact fixed-multiplier class lattices and all-degree multivariable suspension closure with full global filtration. HC4MYIM0/1/2/3 add parameter-extension irreducibility, moving-row invariant vanishing, an exact content-fibre criterion and uniform adapted global frames. The IM3 determinant-one parameter matrix covers moving B, multivariable monic-leading b and arbitrary affine root terms, with a separate primitive-content check. The IM3 frame admits every strict joint degree-gap remainder; its univariate leading-divisibility corollary allows all lower P coefficients. HC4MYIN0/1 replace the former global-frame requirement by rank-two reflexive pencil descent and close every primitive disjoint moving suspension. HC4MYIO0/1/2 extend to arbitrary independent coefficient fields and overlapping polynomial directions; monic and polynomial-Bezout leading overlap outputs have uniform generic filtrations. HC4MYIP0/1/2 use moved relative additive actions instead of positive generic filtrations, and force every surviving overlap image into the multiplier-variable invariant subring. HC4MYIQ0/1/2 descend any univariate generic helper, close every one-helper admitted overlap including nonprimitive content, and reduce HC4 survivors to two-helper invariant plane curves. HC4MYIR0/1/2 close multiplier-zero images in all helper counts and every admitted two-helper overlap in every stable dimension; the complete admitted HC4 overlap family is now closed. IS0/1/2 identify the full JC2 content of an unconditional residual-free extension, including an exact source-correlated class lattice and actual unit-Hessian embeddings with an always invertible constructed gradient. IT0/1/2 give intrinsic finite-energy and inverse-Hessian certificates and a mixed three-direction criterion before any ambient output construction. IU0/1/2 exploit actual free projections and the zero-section first jet, closing critical-value traces and testing the global immersion obligation in a universal noncritical construction. IV0/1/2 separate complete compensation identities from codimension-one source recovery and provide a canonical Legendre-hypersurface normality gate. IW0/1/2 close every constant trace through an infinite-order integral middle-cycle obstruction, with arbitrary helper degrees. IX0/1/2 separate arbitrary quadric plane classes from actual radical-curve recovery and close coordinate-composite or smooth/nonparametric descended nonconstant traces. IY0/1/2 close contractible full-preimage curves and descended cusps, and impose the exact generic-pencil boundary-defect certificate on the remaining multibranch cases. JA0/1/2 force the actual disjoint extra-prime/unit/boundary configuration and bound its one-place part; scalar extra units close the selected one-place case.
lessons_before.avoid: Replacing a global scheme section by generic point counts; replacing a product over the base by an abstract product; assuming cotangent alignment; using squared critical determinants where the unsquared relative orientation is available; extending relative automorphism coverage to arbitrary four-variable mixing; claiming either endpoint solved.
lessons_before.boundary: All base-only normal graph degrees and all relative free-variable polynomial automorphisms are covered, with no alignment assumption. Multiple native full critical points forbid relative unitization over that base. Both plane endpoints remain open, as do arbitrary four-variable source mixing and general two-affine embeddings with three genuinely free-dependent unretained coordinates. One proper relative Morse component now suffices: no condition on other components is needed, and a globally proper everywhere-Morse relative projection can only have degree one. Each nonautomorphic component must therefore fail properness or contain vertical degeneracy. However each single condition separately retains exactly JC2. The universal f_M model has relative projection K and vertical Hessian -DK^T*DK, while the finite-free Fermat construction gives every K a proper relative projection with explicit monomial basis and ramification at zero. Its properness is not properness of K. Neither model automatically supplies a compatible closed ambient embedding. The two plane endpoints and unrestricted graph compatibility remain open. Uniform quadratic two-planes now have the same unique-plane rigidity under nonautomorphy as affine ones: any genuinely quadratic constant two-plane or two distinct quadratic planes closes the candidate. This classifies every fibre-affine two-affine embedding j=(s,t,b+A*w) in all base degrees. Global source generation requires a polynomial left inverse of A; generic rank is not enough. Alignment follows under nonautomorphy, a rank-three helper quadratic closes unconditionally, and lower ranks force a base-only helper and the two old endpoints. All unit-Hessian members have at most one full critical point. Arbitrary nonlinear free helpers and nonaligned potentials of free degree at least three remain open. Nonlinear isotropic-ideal image graphs now have explicit global quadratic isometries to hyperplanes, with arbitrary coefficients in unchanged variables and all source parameterizations. Compatible positive linear ambient weights give a constructive recognition gate: a smooth invariant image either has an isotropic tangent normal forbidding unit Hessian, or its lower-weight nonlinear terms admit a weighted Euler shear to the nonisotropic hyperplane. Only the singleton-zero endpoint survives for these positive images. Actual positive linear source weights would close gradient invertibility, but image invariance alone does not supply that hypothesis after nonlinear source changes. Other nonlinear images and both plane endpoints remain open. The output-base gate now admits arbitrary degrees for both ambient observables: a smooth scheme-theoretic codimension-two complete intersection of their highest forms at infinity forces any carried Keller pair invertible. The leading regular sequence supplies a common filtered basis and height-one graded domains, while the explicitly imported smooth complete-intersection Picard theorem supplies generic factoriality. Generic factoriality alone and smooth reduced support do not suffice; Pi=(x,xy+z^2) has an exact denominator failure. Arbitrary extensions need not have the required leading forms. Singular, nonreduced or excess-dimensional infinity intersections and both plane endpoints remain open. Generic factoriality is now relaxed by HC4MYHW0/1: torsion-free abelian divisor-class monodromy suffices, since Keller function fields contain no nontrivial abelian Galois intermediate field and all conjugate component classes then become zero. Geometric integrality of affine height-one fibres suffices for global primitive saturation even with nonconstant fibre units or reducible graded rings. The earlier r=1 exclusion for nondegenerate linear-quadratic output pairs is removed by HC4MYHW2, without calling the quadric surface factorial; degenerate restricted-rank-at-least-three quadratics close too. HC4MYHW3 closes cyclic Danielewski output pairs in every power m>=2, including nonreduced ordinary leading schemes and generic nonfactoriality outside every older smooth-infinity frame in the HC4-size first type. Nonabelian class actions, torsion, nonintegral height-one fibres, uncovered ranks and infinity schemes and both plane endpoints remain open. The nonabelian boundary is now narrower: HC4MYHX0/1 prove that a nowhere-critical polynomial parameter is relatively algebraically closed in the source field, using an explicit classical closed-polynomial import. A class action descending from a finite cover of that one parameter retains its full possibly nonabelian group under Keller base change, so the component classes become principal. This does not make all special parameter fibres irreducible or the whole Keller extension trivial. HC4MYHX2 closes every constant-coefficient nonconstant Danielewski P(z), with arbitrary root group, and every suspended T*Y+xy-B(T,z) with arbitrary two-variable B and all degrees. The earlier nonabelian-P(z) and suspended-coefficient escape proposals are retired. Genuinely two-parameter unsuspended monodromy, torsion, nonintegral height-one fibres, other missing filtrations and both plane endpoints remain open. HC4MYHY0 now preserves irreducibility of every normal finite monogenic cover under Keller base change, in every dimension and degree. All conjugate constant cross-resultants and integral roots rule out inertia crossing; explicit purity and finite-cover comparison inputs make the quotient trivial. HC4MYHY1 closes every two-parameter P(T,z) with nonzero constant leading z coefficient: root transitivity, without full splitting-group preservation, makes the invariant root-divisor classes zero. HC4MYHY2 forbids a globally monogenic finite normalization for any nontrivial Keller intermediate field; a nonautomorphic plane normalization needs at least two additional global algebra generators. Generic primitive elements do not provide normal monogenic models. Nonconstant leading coefficients, nonnormal monic presentations, nonglobally-monogenic normal finite algebras, other embeddings and both plane endpoints remain open. HC4MYHZ0 computes the exact torsion-free localized-unit defect as the sum of the reduced full-fibre component lattices at the zeros of a(T). HC4MYHZ1 preserves normal monogenic root-cover irreducibility on that vertical open when just those finitely many full K1-fibres are irreducible. The remaining finite etale generic-affine-line quotient is a finite Galois parameter extension, eliminated using HC4MYHX0; the explicitly imported Riemann-Hurwitz formula proves the constant-field descent. HC4MYHZ2 consequently closes every nonmonic P(T,z) under that finite-fibre gate. Independently, abelian generic root monodromy closes all such P without the fibre hypothesis, including every z degree one or two and arbitrary translated powers a(T)*(z-b(T))^m+c(T). A remaining nonautomorphic realization in this family needs both nonabelian generic root monodromy and positive localized-unit defect at a leading-coefficient zero. Generic parameter regularity does not supply the finite-fibre hypothesis, and etale affine curve maps are not automatically finite. The audited Tian-Sun 2024 claims are excluded as proof inputs. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIA0 upgrades the cyclic obstruction to full preservation of every finite nilpotent Galois target group under Keller base change in every dimension: a proper source image lies below a normal cyclic prime quotient, which would give a forbidden intermediate field. HC4MYIA1 therefore permits finite nilpotent class monodromy in the filtered output criterion. HC4MYIA2 closes every nonmonic xy-P(T,z) with nilpotent generic root group without a special-fibre assumption, including arbitrary-depth common-prime radical compositions and every composition of arbitrary quadratics. The explicit nonmonic quartic T*(z^2-T)^2 has nonabelian D8 group and is newly closed even without K1=0 irreducible. The remaining branch in this full family needs both nonnilpotent generic root monodromy and positive localized-unit defect at a leading zero. Arbitrary solvable groups do not follow: an S3 order-two subgroup escapes all normal prime-index containers. General wreath embeddings are primary context, not an additional proof import; the restricted common-prime construction is proved directly. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIB0 now excludes every finite Galois intermediate target-field extension inside a complex Keller field, in every dimension and without a group restriction: a visible index-one place reaches all primes by Galois conjugacy, then explicit purity and finite-cover inputs force triviality. This does not assert arbitrary full splitting-group preservation. HC4MYIB1 identifies the finite plane normalization class group exactly as the free group on the omitted boundary divisors; a torsion or globally factorial normalization forces the inverse. Local factoriality alone is insufficient. HC4MYIB2 closes the filtered output criterion when divisor-class stabilizers are subnormal in an arbitrary finite class-action image; normal class stabilizers suffice even for nonnilpotent groups. The Hurwitz lattice gives an explicit nonnilpotent class-module certificate, without an asserted ambient realization. The S3 root-lattice order-two stabilizer is not subnormal and remains a genuine boundary. Within nonmonic xy-P(T,z), positive localized-unit defect and nonnilpotent monodromy remain necessary unless another retained gate closes the case. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIC0 now constrains every source root-factor degree by m/gcd(m,q_1,...,q_k) when leading-drop coefficient orders lie above the single-slope chords; coprime combined orders give irreducibility and close the carried output in arbitrary z degree without a special-fibre or monodromy hypothesis. HC4MYIC1 clears a rational root to a polynomial label with an exact vertical-Jacobian identity. The constructed polynomial map omits its normalized critical curve, so the explicit qualitative Jelonek-Lason nonproperness input forces each critical component to have affine normalization A1. Independently a square-free leading coefficient dividing the next coefficient excludes rational roots. HC4MYIC2 consequently closes nonmonic cubics if a is square-free and divides b, or if the critical discriminant D=b^2-3ac has square-free part of degree at least two. This includes new S3 families with unbounded T degree and no special-fibre hypothesis. The remaining cubic branch requires a rational label, positive localized-unit defect, S3 group, D of square-free degree at most one, and failure of the independent no-pole gate; D=0 was already cyclic and closed. Critical and root discriminants are distinct, and no-rational-root is not irreducibility in arbitrary higher degree. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIC1 also gives a quantitative critical-branch unit budget: if the normalized derivative Q_U has ell distinct rational roots over C(T), monicity puts them in C[T], and the corresponding polynomial labels u-beta_i(f) are localized source units with linearly independent classes modulo C(f)^*. Hence the exact localized-unit defect sum_(a(c)=0)(r_c-1) is at least ell. For a cubic with D=b^2-3ac a nonzero square, the two distinct rational critical roots force defect at least two. This counts rational critical roots, not every root after a parameter-field extension, and does not close the residual by itself. HC4MYID0 now gives precise allowed supports for all irreducible normalized critical factors over C(T), not only rational branches: H_i(f,u) can vanish only above leading levels with H_i(c,0)=0. Independence gives every subset rank inequality, so extra defect at an excluded level cannot help. An empty support, equivalently gcd(a,H_i(T,0))=1, excludes a rational root in every degree without a special-fibre hypothesis. HC4MYID1 closes cubic square-critical-discriminant outputs whenever gcd(a,b-H)=1 or gcd(a,b+H)=1, including arbitrary pure-power leading multiplicities with b nonzero at the sole leading zero and the explicit S3 family T^q*z^3+z^2-(2R+T^q*R^2)*z/3+d. No new external theorem is imported. A surviving square-discriminant cubic needs nonempty support for both branches and the subset defect budgets; when gcd(a,b)=1, two separate reducible full f-fibres are required. The two-level coefficient control T*(T-1)*z^3+z^2-4*z/3 passes this necessary support test and is not closed by it. No higher-degree irreducibility is inferred from no rational roots. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYID2 adds a global singleton-support pencil obstruction: two reduced rational critical units, each supported at one leading level, force their polynomial critical branches to differ by a nonzero constant. Mutual divisibility modulo the reduced units and ordinary polynomial degrees prove this in arbitrary degrees. In the cubic case a square-free leading coefficient with at most two zeros and gcd(a,b)=1 makes the two populated critical units reduced by the valuation-two Jacobian identity. Thus a nonconstant square critical gap H closes the output even when the support gcd test passes. The old coefficient control T*(T-1)*z^3+z^2-4*z/3 is now closed. A new residual has a=T*(T-1), b=1-2T, c=4/3, H^2=1 and constant critical gap; it is not closed by this argument. Repeated leading multiplicities require a separate reducedness audit. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYID2 further reduces the remaining two-simple-leading-level constant-critical-gap subclass, in all coefficient degrees, to the one fixed output model (T,xy-[T*(T-1)*z^3+(1-2T)*z^2+4*z/3]). The proof writes the affine parameter change, polynomial z shift, constant rescaling, target shear and their inverses, transporting closed embedding data and Keller invertibility in both directions. This is an output-data normal form; the fixed-model endpoint is closed by HC4MYID3, and any fixed quadratic potential must be transported literally rather than assuming Hessian invariance. Increasing coefficient degrees in this output subclass adds no new output-base geometry. HC4MYID3 closes the fixed constant-gap cubic output model. A rational root label gives reduced critical units and polynomial quotients p,q; their difference and the label give a dominant polynomial second chart (A,t). The cleared root equation forces that chart to omit the hyperbola A*(t+1)=3 except possibly one point. The explicit retained Jelonek-Lason nonproperness theorem forbids this, since a hyperbola has no nonconstant polynomial A1 parametrization. Therefore the fixed cubic stays irreducible under every plane Keller base change. Together with HC4MYID2 this closes all cubic outputs with square-free leading a having at most two zeros, gcd(a,b)=1 and nonzero square critical discriminant, in every coefficient and embedding degree. The constant-gap fixed model is retired; the output normal form still does not imply fixed-potential Hessian invariance. Nonsquare linear critical part, more leading levels, repeated-level reducedness and higher-degree factorization branches remain open, as do both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2. HC4MYIE0 now proves in every z degree m>=3 that any rational source root must have an actual intermediate pole 0<r<ord_c(a) at a multiple leading zero. Absence of such poles forces R=D^(m-2), polynomial quotients and a generically finite polynomial map from the original A2 to an integral cyclic derivative surface; the root equation makes it omit a Cstar boundary curve except finitely many points, forbidden by the retained Jelonek-Lason theorem. The integer coefficient pole spectrum excludes roots whenever only full poles are permitted; gcd(a,a_prime,b_(m-1))=1 suffices. HC4MYIE1 separately proves full arbitrary-degree irreducibility for balanced monic rescaling P=A^(m-1)z^m+sum A^(i-1)c_i z^i+d when its explicit finite monic surface is normal; every square-free A is allowed, and the triple gcd F,F_U,F_T at each repeated A zero gives the more general normality test. HC4MYIE2 closes every cubic with square-free leading a of arbitrary degree, every cubic with gcd(a,b)=1, and every cubic with leading parameter degree at most two, without a critical-discriminant restriction or special-fibre assumption. This supersedes earlier residual wording concerning square-free-leading nonsquare-linear critical parts and additional square-free leading levels. Remaining cubic rational roots require actual intermediate poles at joint zeros of a,a_prime,b and failure of this normal monic rescaling and the other retained gates. The target gcd(a,a_prime,b_(m-1))=1 guarantees that coprimality. At V=infinity all normalized-root differences have valuation -1/m, so every pair gives ell_i/d_i+ell_j/d_j=1/m with sum ell_i=0. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIG0 supplies an all-degree rational-parameter regularity test: every finite reduced pencil member must be nonconstant and square-free. At most one projective parameter point can have constant point form; Riemann-Hurwitz forces any nontrivial composition to give a forbidden constant finite member. General coefficient variation, rational affine representations not meeting the stated polynomial or parameter tests, two unequal factors outside these new closures, other joint repeated-leading cases and other outputs remain open. In particular every sparse a(T)z^m+b(T)z^(m-1)+d(T), a nonzero, closes fully in all degrees without any gcd or leading multiplicity restriction. If sigma=sum(1-1/M_lambda)<2, every composition degree is excluded by the per-fibre bound (d-1)(1-1/M_lambda) and Riemann-Hurwitz. lessons_before.title: Test absolute irreducibility before extracting a carrier from a polynomial phase
lessons_before.when: A generating-phase Fourier module, projective matrix summand, or higher polynomial momentum correction g_h is proposed to construct a finite-left Long carrier.
lessons_before.use: Use the exact phase with F_a=-(s-g(a))^2/8 and its full right matrix action, rather than infer relations from a left model. For any nonconstant finite polynomial g, the Fourier exponential module is simple and becomes a polynomial nonsingular connection of position rank2*deg(g). On affine space algebraic horizontal subspaces over finite covers are single-valued and descend rationally, so this connection remains irreducible. This forbids every algebraic rank-one extraction in the entire phase form, including arbitrary higher-degree g_h terms. The original quadratic case also has a direct weighted-order2/3 obstruction. Formal extraction is the explicit Riccati recurrence, globally admitted by pole clearing and one complete finite exception seed; its coefficients have degree10n-1 and momentum order n.
lessons_before.avoid: Adding ever higher finite g_h powers within this phase form to seek a projector, treating A_2 to Mat_2(A_2) as a matrix endomorphism, retaining the bad second branch globally, or inferring all-representative nonlifting from this chosen model or its divergent formal branch.
lessons_before.boundary: The all-degree nonsplitting assumes the stated polynomial phase form and a nonconstant finite g over the generic constant field. It covers finite algebraic function-field extensions, not arbitrary completed position coefficients. The nonsingular polynomial-connection proof is written and not independently reviewed. Different algebraizations and unrelated high-order or nonpositional full carriers remain outside QPH1; QFT1 below specifies which rational singular phase repairs are also excluded. The linear-g control has a different finite scalar quantization despite nonsplitting of its phase model, demonstrating this exact boundary. The Riccati construction is another unbounded global formal lift, not a finite carrier. QFT1 extends the phase exclusion to every minimal rational pre-Fourier line with h-regular coefficient and classical polynomial degree at least three, including logarithmic amplitudes and moving rational poles. Its one-puncture monodromy criterion is uniform over all finite covers in rank at least three. A true rank-two split and generic-rank-two/formal-rank-one degeneration mark the boundary: higher generic pre-Fourier rank and separately audited nonminimal constituents remain possible. No actual Long carrier follows. QKR1 supplies an all-rank cyclic-cover budget r>=(1-1/e)N+irr_0; N>2r excludes cyclic power splitting and, with one finite puncture, all finite covers. Boundary delta factors add inverse-Fourier rank. A genuinely splitting all-degree family S=g(a)+2v has inverse rank deg(g)+1, but its quadratic Long branch fails QSO2. QVM1 excludes every finite mate, on all finite coefficient covers, when S has v-leading term v*H(a), deg H>=2 and root-multiplicity gcd one, with arbitrary lower-growth terms. The candidate v*(2+h*a^3)+4a-3r*a^2 passes N6/r3 and branch extraction but fails this all-order mate test. Proper-power H, different leading faces and nonpositional first images remain outside it. No actual Long carrier follows. QVL1 transports repeated roots to nonlinear ordinary infinity limits and closes all proper-power v-linear repairs when lower coefficients are bounded. Together with QVM1, every leading H of degree>=2 is excluded in that entire Laurent class, with arbitrary finite partner order and algebraic coefficient covers. Euler limits and finite Newton support certificates give further tests. A remaining exact-R scalar Long model in the v-linear rational Laurent class has H degree<=1 and inverse-Fourier rank at least four, by QSO2 and a positive infinity Newton contribution. The family 2v*(1+h*a)^k+4a-3ra^2 is excluded for every k>=2, even though k3 passes N6/r3 and branch extraction. Nonlinear-limit commuting Darboux algebras cannot supply a scalar generator, but other operators in larger idealizers remain outside that assertion. Other leading faces, fractional positive lower growth for nonprimitive H, H degree<=1 and nonpositional first images remain open. QZM1 gives a zero-mode cokernel test with finite-cover trace retraction and covariance under actual finite algebra automorphisms, provided the module is transported too. A new position localization can kill the vector and is not justified by trace. It excludes v*(lambda*a+mu)+G(a) for every nonconstant polynomial G and every finite scalar mate order or algebraic coefficient cover. Combined with QVL1, the pure separable class v*H(a)+G(a) with both H and G nonconstant is closed; the leading-linear rank-four cubic and derivative-tuned cubic are excluded. QPC1 subsequently closes the H-constant nonlinear-G case by a universal p-power coefficient. The complete pure polynomial v*H(a)+G(a) Long form is therefore excluded, including every finite momentum degree and coefficient cover. Additional negative-v corrections, genuine mixed coefficients, other leading faces and deformed first images remain outside this classification. Conditional global pair transport clears c(R) and requires [R,T]=0; it neither admits every chart formula nor identifies QRF2 with this new class. QPC1 also gives linear trace descent for a fixed operator mate and the necessary matrix-fiber condition chi_S derivative zero. Scalar p-centrality requires central degree p and fails for general phase matrices; no arbitrary carrier exclusion follows. QSC1 proves Cent_classical(R,S)=K[R,S] and commutativity of the full formal joint centralizer for every commuting Long deformation, including nonpositional first images. Faithful finite/corner and QMC1 full-carrier endomorphism algebras inherit commutativity. Global spectral Koszul classes exactly test the two individual conjugates; if they vanish, one algebraic curvature class exactly tests flat completion. All spectral fibers can pass while the global class fails, and a formally exact curvature can have nonzero rational double residue. If both matrix positions are scalar, normalized matrix trace scalarizes a full completion without degree growth. This does not scalarize genuinely matrix-valued positions or free a projective carrier, identify QRF2, or construct a finite Long lift.

lessons_before.title: Use uniform cubic-derivative vanishing to force the cotangent plane and classify every fibre-affine two-affine embedding
lessons_before.when: A constant two-plane has uniform source degree at most two, or a quadratic ambient embedding has three helpers affine in two free variables with arbitrary base coefficients.
lessons_before.use: Exhaust Tang projection ranks. A transverse plane yields a quadratic Keller pair, and a rank-one projection yields a component affine in one variable; the note reproduces both polynomial inverses. Thus any nonautomorphic quadratic plane must be the unique jointly affine plane. For a fibre-affine embedding, recover global source generation through a polynomial left inverse of its coefficient matrix. Nonautomorphy then forces a two-dimensional isotropic helper image: rank three is impossible, while rank two and one force a whole base-only helper and the old endpoint classification. Both conditional endpoints have actual affine-free source recovery. An unbounded control has all three helpers free-dependent and only two affine projections. HC4MYHU0/1 now rectify isotropic-ideal image graphs explicitly and classify every compatible positive-weight invariant image into the singleton orbit or a degenerate critical-point obstruction, without assuming equivariance in actual source coordinates. HC4MYHV0/1 now test arbitrary-degree ambient output observables by a global filtered criterion and a smooth scheme-theoretic complete intersection at infinity, with the Picard input explicit. HC4MYHW0/1 replace factoriality by torsion-free abelian divisor-class monodromy and replace height-one graded domains by geometrically integral affine fibres; HC4MYHW2/3 close r=1 quadric pairs, specified degenerate ranks and all cyclic Danielewski powers. HC4MYHX0/1 preserve arbitrary finite monodromy descending from a regular polynomial parameter; HC4MYHX2 closes all constant-coefficient Danielewski P(z) and every T*Y+xy-B(T,z) suspension in every degree, beyond the earlier abelian class-action gate. HC4MYHY0/1 now close normal finite monogenic root covers and every monic two-parameter Danielewski output by root transitivity; HC4MYHY2 imposes a global nonmonogenicity gate on every nontrivial finite Keller normalization. HC4MYHZ0/1/2 supply the finite leading-fibre gate and independent abelian-root gate for nonmonic outputs, with exact localized-unit defect. HC4MYIA0/1/2 upgrade the unconditional nonmonic gate to finite nilpotent root/class groups and arbitrary common-prime radical depth. HC4MYIB0/1/2 add arbitrary Galois-intermediate exclusion, the exact global normalization-boundary basis, and subnormal class-stabilizer closure beyond nilpotent actions. HC4MYIC0/1/2 add combined leading-order factor divisibility, rational-label critical-curve geometry and new unrestricted-parameter S3 cubic closures. HC4MYID0/1 refine critical units to factor-specific supports and all subset rank budgets, closing a new square-discriminant S3 family with arbitrary leading multiplicity. HC4MYID2 closes reduced singleton critical units with nonconstant separation, including the cubic two-simple-leading-level case. HC4MYID3 closes the fixed cubic by a polynomial second chart omitting a hyperbola and consequently the entire specified two-simple-level square-critical class. HC4MYIE0/1/2 supply the intermediate-pole necessity, cyclic derivative surface, normal monic rescaling and unrestricted square-free-leading cubic closure. HC4MYIF0/1/2 constrain every source factorization, close square-free-leading quartics and supply a field-degree and nonnormal-order obstruction for the remaining unequal pair. HC4MYIG0/1/2 add reduced-pencil rational monodromy, one-exception polynomial parameters and all-degree scaled and reciprocal-scaled one-variable output closures. The same mechanism now closes rational scalings and rational affine input with polynomial output translation, including all sparse two-positive-term outputs without a gcd condition. HC4MYIH0/1/2 add the strict projective multiplicity bound, exact affine-in-V exception certificate and all-degree mixed-critical-value expansion outputs. HC4MYII0/1/2/3/4 add plane intermediate-branch geometry, unrestricted rational affine parameters, actual-inertia quotient certificates, all nonadjacent pure-power binomials and every cubic output. HC4MYIJ0/1/2/3 add relative central-series descent, actual product-cover preservation with arbitrary parameter monodromy, and the all-degree finite-critical-pole binomial certificate. HC4MYIK0/1/2/3 add parameter-cover unit norms, integral algebraic monic models, a direct critical-value valuation lemma and unrestricted plane polynomial-output closure. HC4MYIL0/1/2 add generative factor transfer, exact fixed-multiplier class lattices and all-degree multivariable suspension closure with full global filtration. HC4MYIM0/1/2/3 add parameter-extension irreducibility, moving-row invariant vanishing, an exact content-fibre criterion and uniform adapted global frames. The IM3 determinant-one parameter matrix covers moving B, multivariable monic-leading b and arbitrary affine root terms, with a separate primitive-content check. The IM3 frame admits every strict joint degree-gap remainder; its univariate leading-divisibility corollary allows all lower P coefficients. HC4MYIN0/1 replace the former global-frame requirement by rank-two reflexive pencil descent and close every primitive disjoint moving suspension. HC4MYIO0/1/2 extend to arbitrary independent coefficient fields and overlapping polynomial directions; monic and polynomial-Bezout leading overlap outputs have uniform generic filtrations. HC4MYIP0/1/2 use moved relative additive actions instead of positive generic filtrations, and force every surviving overlap image into the multiplier-variable invariant subring. HC4MYIQ0/1/2 descend any univariate generic helper, close every one-helper admitted overlap including nonprimitive content, and reduce HC4 survivors to two-helper invariant plane curves. HC4MYIR0/1/2 close multiplier-zero images in all helper counts and every admitted two-helper overlap in every stable dimension; the complete admitted HC4 overlap family is now closed. IS0/1/2 identify the full JC2 content of an unconditional residual-free extension, including an exact source-correlated class lattice and actual unit-Hessian embeddings with an always invertible constructed gradient. IT0/1/2 give intrinsic finite-energy and inverse-Hessian certificates and a mixed three-direction criterion before any ambient output construction. IU0/1/2 exploit actual free projections and the zero-section first jet, closing critical-value traces and testing the global immersion obligation in a universal noncritical construction. IV0/1/2 separate complete compensation identities from codimension-one source recovery and provide a canonical Legendre-hypersurface normality gate. IW0/1/2 close every constant trace through an infinite-order integral middle-cycle obstruction, with arbitrary helper degrees. IX0/1/2 separate arbitrary quadric plane classes from actual radical-curve recovery and close coordinate-composite or smooth/nonparametric descended nonconstant traces. IY0/1/2 close contractible full-preimage curves and descended cusps, and impose the exact generic-pencil boundary-defect certificate on the remaining multibranch cases. IZ0/1/2 match the intrinsic generic genus on all one-place zero curves and close every rank-one descended trace, including all internally multibranch cases and positive-power rational descent. JA0/1/2 force the actual disjoint extra-prime/unit/boundary configuration and bound its one-place part; scalar extra units close the selected one-place case.
lessons_before.avoid: Checking one fibre or one cubic derivative instead of the four uniform identities; assuming that a quadratic plane is automatically affine without the unit-Hessian hypothesis; using generic matrix rank instead of a polynomial left inverse; assuming alignment as an input; extending the result to arbitrary nonlinear helpers; claiming an endpoint resolved.
lessons_before.boundary: All base coefficient degrees and every constant helper-block rank are covered for genuine fibre-affine two-affine embeddings. Their unit-Hessian members have at most one full critical point. Nonautomorphic rank-one members give the singleton endpoint; rank two permits both endpoints. Nonaligned potentials of free degree at least three, aligned nonlinear-helper embeddings and both plane endpoints remain open. Nonlinear isotropic-ideal image graphs now have explicit global quadratic isometries to hyperplanes, with arbitrary coefficients in unchanged variables and all source parameterizations. Compatible positive linear ambient weights give a constructive recognition gate: a smooth invariant image either has an isotropic tangent normal forbidding unit Hessian, or its lower-weight nonlinear terms admit a weighted Euler shear to the nonisotropic hyperplane. Only the singleton-zero endpoint survives for these positive images. Actual positive linear source weights would close gradient invertibility, but image invariance alone does not supply that hypothesis after nonlinear source changes. Other nonlinear images and both plane endpoints remain open. The output-base gate now admits arbitrary degrees for both ambient observables: a smooth scheme-theoretic codimension-two complete intersection of their highest forms at infinity forces any carried Keller pair invertible. The leading regular sequence supplies a common filtered basis and height-one graded domains, while the explicitly imported smooth complete-intersection Picard theorem supplies generic factoriality. Generic factoriality alone and smooth reduced support do not suffice; Pi=(x,xy+z^2) has an exact denominator failure. Arbitrary extensions need not have the required leading forms. Singular, nonreduced or excess-dimensional infinity intersections and both plane endpoints remain open. Generic factoriality is now relaxed by HC4MYHW0/1: torsion-free abelian divisor-class monodromy suffices, since Keller function fields contain no nontrivial abelian Galois intermediate field and all conjugate component classes then become zero. Geometric integrality of affine height-one fibres suffices for global primitive saturation even with nonconstant fibre units or reducible graded rings. The earlier r=1 exclusion for nondegenerate linear-quadratic output pairs is removed by HC4MYHW2, without calling the quadric surface factorial; degenerate restricted-rank-at-least-three quadratics close too. HC4MYHW3 closes cyclic Danielewski output pairs in every power m>=2, including nonreduced ordinary leading schemes and generic nonfactoriality outside every older smooth-infinity frame in the HC4-size first type. Nonabelian class actions, torsion, nonintegral height-one fibres, uncovered ranks and infinity schemes and both plane endpoints remain open. The nonabelian boundary is now narrower: HC4MYHX0/1 prove that a nowhere-critical polynomial parameter is relatively algebraically closed in the source field, using an explicit classical closed-polynomial import. A class action descending from a finite cover of that one parameter retains its full possibly nonabelian group under Keller base change, so the component classes become principal. This does not make all special parameter fibres irreducible or the whole Keller extension trivial. HC4MYHX2 closes every constant-coefficient nonconstant Danielewski P(z), with arbitrary root group, and every suspended T*Y+xy-B(T,z) with arbitrary two-variable B and all degrees. The earlier nonabelian-P(z) and suspended-coefficient escape proposals are retired. Genuinely two-parameter unsuspended monodromy, torsion, nonintegral height-one fibres, other missing filtrations and both plane endpoints remain open. HC4MYHY0 now preserves irreducibility of every normal finite monogenic cover under Keller base change, in every dimension and degree. All conjugate constant cross-resultants and integral roots rule out inertia crossing; explicit purity and finite-cover comparison inputs make the quotient trivial. HC4MYHY1 closes every two-parameter P(T,z) with nonzero constant leading z coefficient: root transitivity, without full splitting-group preservation, makes the invariant root-divisor classes zero. HC4MYHY2 forbids a globally monogenic finite normalization for any nontrivial Keller intermediate field; a nonautomorphic plane normalization needs at least two additional global algebra generators. Generic primitive elements do not provide normal monogenic models. Nonconstant leading coefficients, nonnormal monic presentations, nonglobally-monogenic normal finite algebras, other embeddings and both plane endpoints remain open. HC4MYHZ0 computes the exact torsion-free localized-unit defect as the sum of the reduced full-fibre component lattices at the zeros of a(T). HC4MYHZ1 preserves normal monogenic root-cover irreducibility on that vertical open when just those finitely many full K1-fibres are irreducible. The remaining finite etale generic-affine-line quotient is a finite Galois parameter extension, eliminated using HC4MYHX0; the explicitly imported Riemann-Hurwitz formula proves the constant-field descent. HC4MYHZ2 consequently closes every nonmonic P(T,z) under that finite-fibre gate. Independently, abelian generic root monodromy closes all such P without the fibre hypothesis, including every z degree one or two and arbitrary translated powers a(T)*(z-b(T))^m+c(T). A remaining nonautomorphic realization in this family needs both nonabelian generic root monodromy and positive localized-unit defect at a leading-coefficient zero. Generic parameter regularity does not supply the finite-fibre hypothesis, and etale affine curve maps are not automatically finite. The audited Tian-Sun 2024 claims are excluded as proof inputs. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIA0 upgrades the cyclic obstruction to full preservation of every finite nilpotent Galois target group under Keller base change in every dimension: a proper source image lies below a normal cyclic prime quotient, which would give a forbidden intermediate field. HC4MYIA1 therefore permits finite nilpotent class monodromy in the filtered output criterion. HC4MYIA2 closes every nonmonic xy-P(T,z) with nilpotent generic root group without a special-fibre assumption, including arbitrary-depth common-prime radical compositions and every composition of arbitrary quadratics. The explicit nonmonic quartic T*(z^2-T)^2 has nonabelian D8 group and is newly closed even without K1=0 irreducible. The remaining branch in this full family needs both nonnilpotent generic root monodromy and positive localized-unit defect at a leading zero. Arbitrary solvable groups do not follow: an S3 order-two subgroup escapes all normal prime-index containers. General wreath embeddings are primary context, not an additional proof import; the restricted common-prime construction is proved directly. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIB0 now excludes every finite Galois intermediate target-field extension inside a complex Keller field, in every dimension and without a group restriction: a visible index-one place reaches all primes by Galois conjugacy, then explicit purity and finite-cover inputs force triviality. This does not assert arbitrary full splitting-group preservation. HC4MYIB1 identifies the finite plane normalization class group exactly as the free group on the omitted boundary divisors; a torsion or globally factorial normalization forces the inverse. Local factoriality alone is insufficient. HC4MYIB2 closes the filtered output criterion when divisor-class stabilizers are subnormal in an arbitrary finite class-action image; normal class stabilizers suffice even for nonnilpotent groups. The Hurwitz lattice gives an explicit nonnilpotent class-module certificate, without an asserted ambient realization. The S3 root-lattice order-two stabilizer is not subnormal and remains a genuine boundary. Within nonmonic xy-P(T,z), positive localized-unit defect and nonnilpotent monodromy remain necessary unless another retained gate closes the case. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIC0 now constrains every source root-factor degree by m/gcd(m,q_1,...,q_k) when leading-drop coefficient orders lie above the single-slope chords; coprime combined orders give irreducibility and close the carried output in arbitrary z degree without a special-fibre or monodromy hypothesis. HC4MYIC1 clears a rational root to a polynomial label with an exact vertical-Jacobian identity. The constructed polynomial map omits its normalized critical curve, so the explicit qualitative Jelonek-Lason nonproperness input forces each critical component to have affine normalization A1. Independently a square-free leading coefficient dividing the next coefficient excludes rational roots. HC4MYIC2 consequently closes nonmonic cubics if a is square-free and divides b, or if the critical discriminant D=b^2-3ac has square-free part of degree at least two. This includes new S3 families with unbounded T degree and no special-fibre hypothesis. The remaining cubic branch requires a rational label, positive localized-unit defect, S3 group, D of square-free degree at most one, and failure of the independent no-pole gate; D=0 was already cyclic and closed. Critical and root discriminants are distinct, and no-rational-root is not irreducibility in arbitrary higher degree. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIC1 also gives a quantitative critical-branch unit budget: if the normalized derivative Q_U has ell distinct rational roots over C(T), monicity puts them in C[T], and the corresponding polynomial labels u-beta_i(f) are localized source units with linearly independent classes modulo C(f)^*. Hence the exact localized-unit defect sum_(a(c)=0)(r_c-1) is at least ell. For a cubic with D=b^2-3ac a nonzero square, the two distinct rational critical roots force defect at least two. This counts rational critical roots, not every root after a parameter-field extension, and does not close the residual by itself. HC4MYID0 now gives precise allowed supports for all irreducible normalized critical factors over C(T), not only rational branches: H_i(f,u) can vanish only above leading levels with H_i(c,0)=0. lessons_before.title: Separate generic connection rank from formal rank before repairing a Fourier branch
lessons_before.when: A rational phase correction, logarithmic amplitude, finite singularity, moving pole or finite algebraic cover is proposed to split the Long Fourier carrier.
lessons_before.use: First remove integral-residue apparent regular poles in the pre-Fourier line. For every rational h-regular coefficient reducing to a polynomial of degree ell>=3, the minimal Fourier module remains irreducible after every finite cover. A nonconstant polynomial part gives no finite singularity; a constant part gives rank at least ell and one finite monodromy with all but one eigenvalue1. A cyclic self-twist and three-trace argument rules out splitting uniformly, without a pole or degree search. Test proposed repairs against a genuine rank-two split and a generic-rank-two/formal-rank-one control.
lessons_before.avoid: Adding rational corrections or logarithmic amplitudes within the minimal line ansatz, using raw apparent-pole order as minimal rank, assuming stable behavior at infinity when poles move with h, or inferring generic connection rank one from formal classical rank one.
lessons_before.boundary: Only simple minimal extensions of rational pre-Fourier line connections with the stated h reduction are covered. The rank-two threshold is real. Higher generic connection rank, nonminimal point-supported constituents and different algebraic models remain outside the theorem and still require full right relations, global admission and finite-left generation. Exact controls do not independently replay the universal D-module or Galois arguments. QKR1 supplies an all-rank cyclic-cover budget r>=(1-1/e)N+irr_0; N>2r excludes cyclic power splitting and, with one finite puncture, all finite covers. Boundary delta factors add inverse-Fourier rank. A genuinely splitting all-degree family S=g(a)+2v has inverse rank deg(g)+1, but its quadratic Long branch fails QSO2. QVM1 excludes every finite mate, on all finite coefficient covers, when S has v-leading term v*H(a), deg H>=2 and root-multiplicity gcd one, with arbitrary lower-growth terms. The candidate v*(2+h*a^3)+4a-3r*a^2 passes N6/r3 and branch extraction but fails this all-order mate test. Proper-power H, different leading faces and nonpositional first images remain outside it. No actual Long carrier follows. QVL1 transports repeated roots to nonlinear ordinary infinity limits and closes all proper-power v-linear repairs when lower coefficients are bounded. Together with QVM1, every leading H of degree>=2 is excluded in that entire Laurent class, with arbitrary finite partner order and algebraic coefficient covers. Euler limits and finite Newton support certificates give further tests. A remaining exact-R scalar Long model in the v-linear rational Laurent class has H degree<=1 and inverse-Fourier rank at least four, by QSO2 and a positive infinity Newton contribution. The family 2v*(1+h*a)^k+4a-3ra^2 is excluded for every k>=2, even though k3 passes N6/r3 and branch extraction. Nonlinear-limit commuting Darboux algebras cannot supply a scalar generator, but other operators in larger idealizers remain outside that assertion. Other leading faces, fractional positive lower growth for nonprimitive H, H degree<=1 and nonpositional first images remain open. QZM1 gives a zero-mode cokernel test with finite-cover trace retraction and covariance under actual finite algebra automorphisms, provided the module is transported too. A new position localization can kill the vector and is not justified by trace. It excludes v*(lambda*a+mu)+G(a) for every nonconstant polynomial G and every finite scalar mate order or algebraic coefficient cover. Combined with QVL1, the pure separable class v*H(a)+G(a) with both H and G nonconstant is closed; the leading-linear rank-four cubic and derivative-tuned cubic are excluded. QPC1 subsequently closes the H-constant nonlinear-G case by a universal p-power coefficient. The complete pure polynomial v*H(a)+G(a) Long form is therefore excluded, including every finite momentum degree and coefficient cover. Additional negative-v corrections, genuine mixed coefficients, other leading faces and deformed first images remain outside this classification. Conditional global pair transport clears c(R) and requires [R,T]=0; it neither admits every chart formula nor identifies QRF2 with this new class. QPC1 also gives linear trace descent for a fixed operator mate and the necessary matrix-fiber condition chi_S derivative zero. Scalar p-centrality requires central degree p and fails for general phase matrices; no arbitrary carrier exclusion follows.
lessons_before.reopen_when: An actual higher-rank generic pre-Fourier connection with the full Long right action and finite global carrier is constructed, boundary constituents pass an independent support/lattice audit, or a theorem forces every eligible carrier into the excluded minimal-line category.
