lessons_before.title: Use source-unit norms and polynomial inertia blocks to close the whole plane polynomial-output class
lessons_before.when: A polynomial output still seems to need leading or coefficient refinements, or a normal monogenic argument is transported through an algebraic parameter cover.
lessons_before.use: Keep the actual finite normal parameter curve and smooth source base change. A factor cross-resultant is a source unit, whose finite-free norm is a nonzero constant on the original polynomial source. All parameter-conjugate monic models make the norm identity prove target integrality of both the resultant and its inverse. Inertia and purity leave a preserved parameter quotient, excluding every proper factor. Integral critical values give such monic models by direct valuation scaling. In the plane, take the normal subgroup of nonparametrizable branch inertia; its block quotient is polynomial by ordinary Luroth and the unique-pole argument. Parametrizable outer critical curves force integral critical values. This proves root transitivity for every P in C(T)[z] of positive degree and the entire polynomial (T,xy-P) carried inverse. HC4MYIL0/1/2 add generative factor transfer, exact fixed-multiplier class lattices and all-degree multivariable suspension closure with full global filtration. HC4MYIM0/1/2/3 add parameter-extension irreducibility, moving-row invariant vanishing, an exact content-fibre criterion and uniform adapted global frames. The IM3 determinant-one parameter matrix covers moving B, multivariable monic-leading b and arbitrary affine root terms, with a separate primitive-content check. The IM3 frame admits every strict joint degree-gap remainder; its univariate leading-divisibility corollary allows all lower P coefficients. HC4MYIN0/1 replace the former global-frame requirement by rank-two reflexive pencil descent and close every primitive disjoint moving suspension. HC4MYIO0/1/2 extend to arbitrary independent coefficient fields and overlapping polynomial directions; monic and polynomial-Bezout leading overlap outputs have uniform generic filtrations. HC4MYIP0/1/2 use moved relative additive actions instead of positive generic filtrations, and force every surviving overlap image into the multiplier-variable invariant subring. HC4MYIQ0/1/2 descend any univariate generic helper, close every one-helper admitted overlap including nonprimitive content, and reduce HC4 survivors to two-helper invariant plane curves. HC4MYIR0/1/2 close multiplier-zero images in all helper counts and every admitted two-helper overlap in every stable dimension; the complete admitted HC4 overlap family is now closed. IS0/1/2 identify the full JC2 content of an unconditional residual-free extension, including an exact source-correlated class lattice and actual unit-Hessian embeddings with an always invertible constructed gradient. IT0/1/2 give intrinsic finite-energy and inverse-Hessian certificates and a mixed three-direction criterion before any ambient output construction. IU0/1/2 exploit actual free projections and the zero-section first jet, closing critical-value traces and testing the global immersion obligation in a universal noncritical construction. IV0/1/2 separate complete compensation identities from codimension-one source recovery and provide a canonical Legendre-hypersurface normality gate. IW0/1/2 close every constant trace through an infinite-order integral middle-cycle obstruction, with arbitrary helper degrees. IX0/1/2 separate arbitrary quadric plane classes from actual radical-curve recovery and close coordinate-composite or smooth/nonparametric descended nonconstant traces. IY0/1/2 close contractible full-preimage curves and descended cusps, and impose the exact generic-pencil boundary-defect certificate on the remaining multibranch cases. IZ0/1/2 match the intrinsic generic genus on all one-place zero curves and close every rank-one descended trace, including all internally multibranch cases and positive-power rational descent. JA0/1/2 force the actual disjoint extra-prime/unit/boundary configuration and bound its one-place part; scalar extra units close the selected one-place case.
lessons_before.avoid: Assuming the parameter-cover source affine space or its units constant; using a norm without putting all conjugate models in a common target splitting field; omitting inverse integrality; silently importing Ritt or dynamical reduction theorems; replacing actual inertia by a discriminant factor; promoting transitivity to full splitting-group equality; extending the plane curve argument to higher-dimensional cylinders; reopening coefficient subclasses already closed by IK3.
lessons_before.boundary: HC4MYIK0/1/2/3 now close the entire plane polynomial output coefficient class. HC4MYIK0 extends normal monogenic irreducibility preservation over a finite algebraic parameter curve: the actual source is smooth and finite free over the original polynomial source, and its cross-resultant units have nonzero constant norms. Integrality of every conjugate monic model makes both the target resultant and its inverse integral; inertia, purity and algebraic section descent finish the proof without assuming constant units or an affine-plane parameter source. HC4MYIK1 admits every integral algebraic affine monic model in all dimensions, and combines the no-pole binomial side with IJ3 to complete all plane binomials. HC4MYIK2 directly proves that integral critical values force integral centered monic coefficients in every degree and every residue-characteristic-zero valuation; no dynamical reduction theorem is imported. HC4MYIK3 uses contained plane bad inertia and its normal-orbit block system. Ordinary one-variable Luroth plus a unique-pole argument gives a polynomial outer block quotient. Its surviving critical curves are polynomially parametrizable, so every outer critical value is integral. IK2/1 make the source outer action transitive, and the contained bad inertia then makes the whole root action transitive. Therefore P(f,Z)+g is irreducible for every nonconstant P in C(T)[z], and every carried closed stable embedding through (T,xy-P(T,z)) with P polynomial of positive z degree and r>=1 forces the plane Keller inverse. Every coefficient, source, embedding, leading multiplicity and z degree is unrestricted. This retires all remaining plane coefficient-profile, unequal-factor, no-finite-pole-binomial and critical-curve refinements for this output class. Full splitting-group preservation is not inferred; earlier stronger group and all-dimensional subclass statements remain valid. The unrestricted final theorem is plane-only. Other output geometries and finding compatible ambient observables for arbitrary graph embeddings remain separate. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIL0/1/2 extend the entire polynomial-output closure to arbitrarily many Z variables and arbitrary fixed polynomial multipliers in disjoint X variables. Minimal inner degree gives P=R(S) over C(T) with S noncomposite. The same closed-polynomial implication is explicitly audited over C(T); a direct relative-field argument makes S-U absolutely generically irreducible without importing special-fibre classification or a coordinate theorem. Every outer irreducibility certificate therefore transfers to P, and HC4MYIK3 gives P(f,Z_1,...,Z_k)+g irreducible for every plane Keller pair and every positive joint degree. For A(X)=c product a_j^e_j independent of T,Z, the generic A(X)Y-P-V fibre is smooth and has exact class lattice direct_sum_j Z^m/Z(1,...,1), m=deg R, independent of e_j. Fixed rows and source outer transitivity make its source-fixed subgroup zero. The original global relation gives a common free filtration and every affine height-one target fibre is geometrically integral. Consequently every carried closed stable embedding through (T,A(X)Y-P(T,Z)), p,k>=1 and r>=p+k-1, forces the plane inverse, with all degrees, variable counts and fixed-multiplier multiplicities unrestricted. Arbitrary ambient and target polynomial automorphism orbits are included. For HC4 this covers arbitrary two-Z P with A=X and arbitrary fixed two-X multiplier with one Z. No full splitting-group or unrestricted higher-dimensional Keller statement is inferred. A parameter-dependent multiplier can have correlated row/root action with nonzero invariants; overlapping variables can also break the fibre argument. Neither case is silently admitted, and neither control is asserted a Keller realization. Other output geometries and finding compatible observables for arbitrary graphs remain distinct. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIM0 proves that every plane polynomial-output equation stays irreducible after every finite algebraic parameter extension E/C(T), equivalently over L kappa_bar, in any number of polynomial root variables. Lift each original bad horizontal inertia group to M E/F, use the explicit Stacks 0BU7 surjectivity lemma, and apply the original plane source theorem before fixing E; horizontal unramifiedness puts the lift into the source subgroup over L E. The same original outer block quotient has integral critical values and its norm proof survives enlargement of the monic-model parameter field. HC4MYIM1 therefore removes generic correlated row/root class invariants for every disjoint parameter-dependent multiplier A(T,X): split its rows over E, retain outer transitivity over L E and get zero source-fixed class subgroup. A global frame is still a separate requirement. HC4MYIM2 identifies the exact height-one fibre condition using the coefficient content delta_A: every P(c,Z) at its zeros must be nonconstant closed, while a constant such level forbids any carried Keller pair by Jacobian divisibility. Either a unit graded leading multiplier coefficient or a unit graded leading root coefficient supplies a global free frame, with all degrees and stable dimensions unrestricted. Other verified frames are allowed. HC4MYIM3 constructs one uniformly beyond both original leading certificates: for (T,(1+h(T)B(X))Y-h(T)b(Z)-Z), B nonconstant and deg b=m>=2, H=B Y-b gives an equivalent global presentation monic in Z, with weights m-1,a+1,m+a and generic domain h B_a H+beta Z^m. Constant coefficient content makes all height-one fibres integral. This closes every admitted degree and supplies actual HC4 unit-Hessian positive controls. Unrestricted parameter-stable irreducibility is plane-only and does not assert full splitting groups. Nonconstant composite content levels, unframed multiplier leading drops, overlapping variables, other output geometries and arbitrary-graph observable existence remain distinct. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. The HC4MYIM3 unimodular parameter-frame extension admits (T,(A_0+h B(T,X))Y-h b(T,Z)-q(T) dot Z-d(T)) in arbitrarily many disjoint Z variables, with gcd(A_0,h)=1, h nonzero, positive generic X degree of B, constant coefficient content of A_0+h B, and a highest-joint-degree graded leading monomial of b of degree m>=2 with nonzero constant coefficient. Choose u A_0+v h=1 and H=B Y-b, J=u H-v Y. The determinant-one parameter matrix gives Y=u(V+q dot Z+d)-h J and H=v(V+q dot Z+d)+A_0 J. The equivalent global relation is (A_0+h B)J+b-(u B-v)(V+q dot Z+d)=0. Weights m-1 on X, a+1 on every Z and m+a on J give highest equation h B_a J+b_m(T,Z), a primitive-linear generic domain. A Z-first order supplies a monic global basis. The constant-content condition is independent of Bezout coprimality; it is automatic for fixed nonconstant B, or a primitive positive-X coefficient row, but not for arbitrary moving B. All lower b coefficients may vary with T. The carried inverse holds for every r>=p+k-1, all source, coefficient and embedding degrees and all admitted variable counts. This is a uniform frame construction, not a claim every missing frame can be repaired this way. The strict joint degree-gap extension of HC4MYIM3 replaces q dot Z+d by any C_0(T,Z) of joint degree at most n<m. With a=deg_X B, weights m-n on X, a+1 on Z and m+a*n on J make h B_a J+b_m the highest equation; the B C_0 term has positive weight gap m-n. The same determinant-one presentation and unit graded leading monomial of b give a global free frame. All independent coprimality and constant multiplier-content hypotheses remain required. Its univariate leading-divisibility corollary closes arbitrary P(T,Z) of degree m>=2 with leading coefficient h whenever the multiplier A has constant coefficient content, positive X degree, and h divides every positive-X coefficient of A. Write A=A_0+h B; content gives gcd(A_0,h)=1. Coefficientwise Euclidean division writes P=h b+C_0 with b monic and deg_Z C_0<m. Every lower coefficient of P is arbitrary. This is a structural all-degree certificate, not a universal frame theorem. HC4MYIN0 removes the common global free-filtration hypothesis for faithfully flat plane-target observables with geometrically integral height-one fibres: a relative derivation bounds the rank-two generic-pencil lattice, normality makes it reflexive, the explicit surface-reflexivity lemma makes it locally free, and faithful flatness prevents the constant section from vanishing. The invertible quotient is trivial on C[T,V], giving a global primitive pencil coordinate and polynomial saturation. Only a generic positive filtration and principal geometric generic image components remain needed. HC4MYIN1 applies this to every disjoint moving suspension (T,A(T,X)Y-P(T,Z)) whose coefficient-content levels P(c,Z) are nonconstant closed. This includes every primitive A with arbitrary P, with all degrees and admitted stable dimensions unrestricted. The ambient observable map is faithfully flat by nonconstant level polynomials and miracle flatness; parameter-stable class vanishing and a generic weighted filtration complete the proof. Earlier leading and Bezout frame certificates are retained sufficient evidence but are no longer requirements in this family. Missing global frames are no longer a frontier for the disjoint exact-content family. Nonconstant composite content levels, overlapping variables, other output geometries and arbitrary-graph observable existence remain distinct. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIO0 permits arbitrary independent coefficient fields D/C(T): every positive-degree P in D[Z] has P+g irreducible over Frac(L tensor_C(T) D), including algebraic coefficients themselves. Original-source inertia is lifted on an algebraic parameter cover, outer critical images give integral critical values, and the norm theorem handles their monic models. Finite coefficient-algebra specialization then gives arbitrary independent fields. HC4MYIO1 applies this on multiplier-component function fields: arbitrary overlap of the X coefficients in P(T,X,Z) has zero generic source-fixed class group if a positive Z direction survives on each geometric factor of A(T,X). Distinct rows may have different component counts. HC4MYIO2 closes these carried outputs when every full content-level polynomial P(c,X,Z) is nonconstant closed and a positive generic filtration is certified. No common global free filtration is required. Monic root terms with arbitrary overlapping lower coefficients, and the broader polynomial Bezout leading family P=a(X)b(Z)+Q with u A+v a=1 over C(T)[X] and deg_Z Q<deg_Z b, have uniform generic filtrations in every degree. Generic freeness, if proved, then suffices for the scalar integral frame. QVA1 promotes the overlap comparison under the additional finite generic rank-one full-action hypotheses. Gauss-regularity forces a principal saturated initial ideal and a C-frame; any completed division intertwiner between two regular full scalar formal graphs is a C-unit. Bare division equivalence or rational spectral images without a finite generic carrier still do not qualify.

lessons_before.title: Use mandatory coefficient costs and source-column units before searching a joint-frame family
lessons_before.when: A parameterized source/output family has many potential cancellation roots and arbitrary output mixing would make direct sparsity optimization difficult.
lessons_before.use: Derive the full coefficient model once. Verify every scalar-times-factor product, then count disjoint mandatory nonzero groups to eliminate expensive parameter cases. Obtain exact indicator formulas on the remaining coordinate planes and check their truth-table identities along with the algebraic compatibility facts giving a full field cover. Before optimizing an arbitrary output matrix, factor each source coefficient vector asg*q and certify a constant linear combination of q entries equal to1; the source column vanishes exactly on g=0. Count nonzero columns and add projective rank/support obstructions where several distinct directions cannot all be coordinate axes. Independently verify matching control determinants and collisions.
lessons_before.avoid: Promoting a small rational grid or Boolean assignment table without its algebraic specialization/coverage proof to a universal field result; dropping parameter roots in a generic gcd; trusting primary factorization; interpreting a gap in normalized conjugacy as a gap for arbitrary output counts; claiming the matching controls total51 as a total-term optimum of all joint frames; rerunning the closed five-parameter family.

The five-position source group has sharp36 normalized only at identity and next39; nonlinear source support is30 at identity and at least33 elsewhere. Every changed source needs at least34 terms with arbitrary outputGL, with matching34 and39 integral controls whose full determinants are checked. lessons_before.title: Reduce multivariable geometric factors to one outer equation and keep fixed multiplier rows separate
lessons_before.when: An ambient output has the form (T,A(X)Y-P(T,Z)) with fixed disjoint multiplier and positive joint Z degree, or a source irreducibility certificate needs transport to several polynomial variables.
lessons_before.use: Minimize the inner degree in P=R(S) over C(T). The noncomposite-to-closed theorem over that field and a direct generic-field argument make every S-alpha_i absolutely irreducible. The outer root action therefore controls all factors. For A=c product a_j^e_j fixed over C, invert A, compute each divisor (a_j,S-alpha_i), and retain the exact row relations div(a_j)=sum_i D_(j,i). The class group is a direct sum of outer root lattices, independent of e_j. Plane source transitivity kills every fixed-row invariant. A monic relation with constant leading coefficient supplies the original global free filtration, and all height-one fibres stay integral, forcing a carried inverse. HC4MYIM0/1/2/3 add parameter-extension irreducibility, moving-row invariant vanishing, an exact content-fibre criterion and uniform adapted global frames. The IM3 determinant-one parameter matrix covers moving B, multivariable monic-leading b and arbitrary affine root terms, with a separate primitive-content check. The IM3 frame admits every strict joint degree-gap remainder; its univariate leading-divisibility corollary allows all lower P coefficients. HC4MYIN0/1 replace the former global-frame requirement by rank-two reflexive pencil descent and close every primitive disjoint moving suspension. HC4MYIO0/1/2 extend to arbitrary independent coefficient fields and overlapping polynomial directions; monic and polynomial-Bezout leading overlap outputs have uniform generic filtrations. HC4MYIP0/1/2 use moved relative additive actions instead of positive generic filtrations, and force every surviving overlap image into the multiplier-variable invariant subring. HC4MYIQ0/1/2 descend any univariate generic helper, close every one-helper admitted overlap including nonprimitive content, and reduce HC4 survivors to two-helper invariant plane curves. HC4MYIR0/1/2 close multiplier-zero images in all helper counts and every admitted two-helper overlap in every stable dimension; the complete admitted HC4 overlap family is now closed. IS0/1/2 identify the full JC2 content of an unconditional residual-free extension, including an exact source-correlated class lattice and actual unit-Hessian embeddings with an always invertible constructed gradient. IT0/1/2 give intrinsic finite-energy and inverse-Hessian certificates and a mixed three-direction criterion before any ambient output construction. IU0/1/2 exploit actual free projections and the zero-section first jet, closing critical-value traces and testing the global immersion obligation in a universal noncritical construction. IV0/1/2 separate complete compensation identities from codimension-one source recovery and provide a canonical Legendre-hypersurface normality gate. IW0/1/2 close every constant trace through an infinite-order integral middle-cycle obstruction, with arbitrary helper degrees. IX0/1/2 separate arbitrary quadric plane classes from actual radical-curve recovery and close coordinate-composite or smooth/nonparametric descended nonconstant traces. IY0/1/2 close contractible full-preimage curves and descended cusps, and impose the exact generic-pencil boundary-defect certificate on the remaining multibranch cases. IZ0/1/2 match the intrinsic generic genus on all one-place zero curves and close every rank-one descended trace, including all internally multibranch cases and positive-power rational descent. JA0/1/2 force the actual disjoint extra-prime/unit/boundary configuration and bound its one-place part; scalar extra units close the selected one-place case.

lessons_before.title: Retain residual quantum degree after saturating the position centralizer
lessons_before.when: A proposed actual Long lift or rank-one projective carrier is modeled by a coefficient-field cover, rational positional normalization or a chosen generic division index.
lessons_before.use: Build the tower W subset U=D(H,T) subset D with H the full rational position centralizer and d=[H:L(F)]. QPD1 and finite whole indices make d finite; differential-field bases give N_l=d*M_l and N_r=d*M_r. For the Long classical position field, H lies in the completed image, so U still completes to that image and M_l,M_r>=3. A nontrivial H has d>=3 and forces whole indices>=9. Pure coefficient-induced models have M=1 and cannot realize the lift. A rational target automorphism making all fixed positions ordinary coefficient functions would also force M=1 and is excluded, even with parameter poles.
lessons_before.avoid: Identifying centralizer degree with whole division degree, treating a nontrivial coefficient cover as the missing completed degree3, assuming generic left/right equality, or extending the fixed-position rational target obstruction to mixed source polarizations or arbitrary formal gauges. Check the polynomial classical joint centralizer and faithful formal frame; unscaled cotangent controls fail that hypothesis. Do not infer that residual extensions of degree greater than one are impossible in rational Weyl division rings; the explicit all-m family disproves that. Do not discard the algebraic nilpotent exception when applying the matrix power test.
lessons_before.boundary: The theorem constrains an actual full tuple and supplies no new Long tuple. A minimal whole index3 remains possible with birational centralizer and residual index3. The rescaled rank-three cotangent control has delta1,d3,M1,N3 and is allowed. A curve-isogeny field is not automatically the position centralizer; QIM1 remains a curve module, not a Weyl realization. No scalar frame, higher-rank matrix exclusion or all-representative nonlifting follows. QCI1 also supplies an arbitrary-rank admission test: bounded Bernstein powers of one proposed rational Weyl generator prohibit every finite full left lattice, in any rational matrix frame. Genuine residual extensions do exist: F_m=x^(1-m)*p/m,T_m=x^m has residual m with F_m as position, including m=3, but its nonpositive-degree F_m excludes every finite diagonal carrier. Swapping positions changes (d,M) from (1,m) to (m,1) without changing the whole index. QGD1 excludes the direct finite-group-quotient mechanism for the full Long image division ring: its non-Galois cubic residue cannot arise from D^G, even with parameter-pole groups and index loss. This uses the full image rather than the fixed position field and transports through arbitrary L-linear rational source/target division changes. A larger S3 Galois closure with an intermediate S2-fixed source, or a nonsymmetric residual embedding, remains possible and still needs finite admission. QGC1 closes natural larger-closure carriers under ordinary-parameter classical graph admission or arbitrary-parameter equivariance with the correct torsion-free degree-two special module. Finite valuation levels or character shifts remove the original saturation requirement. The etale obstruction concerns the extra quadratic field above Long physical target, not the unavoidable degree-three extension above its image. The original rank-one carrier therefore passes the test. Bare field extensions, unfaithful residue or excess special rank do not supply a replacement full carrier. QRA1 companion actions are regular representations from a finite differential-field extension, not the diagonal rational power-cotangent actions excluded by QCI1. Their component powers grow unboundedly and their generic rank is the cover degree. Their degree<=2 does not bound cover degree without bounding matrix size. Irreducibility over the original target division ring blocks rational rank-one extraction of this same regular action. QFR1 shows why generic division tests miss a cusp-supported class. QUR1 proves an all-ramification regular-admission obstruction for the single monic module by repolarization and a moving common zero. This is not an index contradiction, an exclusion of the QRA1 surface actions, or a proof about every Long graph carrier. QVA1 separates the new generic admission gate from an index comparison. A finite generic rank-one full action with the intended Gauss-regular shadow automatically patches to an integral carrier. It does not force equality of generic and completed indices or construct a missing residual extension. Nonprincipal normalized valuation ideals obstruct such regular actions in every degree.
lessons_before.reopen_when: A new full-action Long candidate realizes the required residual extension together with a finite invariant lattice, a structural theorem forbids finite admission for a stated rational-action class, or a new mixed source polarization supplies a different justified classical centralizer. Merely realizing rational residual degree3 is no longer the missing existence gate.

lessons_before.title: Match primary identifiers and retained claims before importing a literature result
lessons_before.when: A literature search or aggregator presents a potentially newer moment/vanishing theorem or counterexample.
lessons_before.use: Open the primary identifier and match title, author and version before using the theorem. Search the whole current ledger, including archived canonical records, before calling a source new. Reconcile changes of multiplier sign and distinguish variable count, operator order and ordinary-Laplacian power. lessons_before.title: Combine divisor filtrations formally before specializing shared polynomial factors
lessons_before.when: Several seed-row valuations are available for divisors that can share roots or specialize to constants, or uniform endpoint step costs overestimate displacement paths.
lessons_before.use: Treat divisors as independent graded variables with compatible derivatives, prove each pole estimate for actual seeds and exact witnesses, combine product divisibility in the formal UFD, and specialize only afterward. Use fractional amplitude grades and ceiling exponents where integral grades fail. Cancel common powers, including negative early powers as multiplication, and scale completed rows. For nonfeeding endpoint paths, bound cumulative cost by exponent displacement before determinant arithmetic.
lessons_before.avoid: Multiplying separate divisibility claims after actual divisors have acquired common factors; assuming specialized coprimality; deriving t-degree savings by dividing constants; taking integer amplitude grades without checking principal branches; omitting denominator/vertical/basis derivatives; inferring odd173 or homogeneous145 from even174/146.

lessons_before.title: Keep coefficient fields independent and use polynomial directions on multiplier components to handle overlap
lessons_before.when: Root coefficients overlap multiplier variables or live in algebraic and function-field parameter extensions.
lessons_before.use: Prove the algebraic-coefficient theorem itself before spreading to arbitrary fields: lift relative bad inertia to the original-target Galois closure, use original plane nonproperness, make outer critical values integral and apply the actual parameter-cover norm theorem. Spread any later factor to a finite coefficient algebra with explicit denominator and degree guards. On each geometric multiplier component, use its independent function field and a surviving polynomial Z direction to get source transitivity. The exact row lattice has zero source-fixed subgroup even for different row component counts. Combine full closed content levels with a generic positive filtration and rank-two reflexive descent. A polynomial Bezout leading coefficient gives a determinant-one presentation with uniform positive weights, including every monic root term with arbitrary overlapping lower coefficients. HC4MYIP0/1/2 use moved relative additive actions instead of positive generic filtrations, and force every surviving overlap image into the multiplier-variable invariant subring. HC4MYIQ0/1/2 descend any univariate generic helper, close every one-helper admitted overlap including nonprimitive content, and reduce HC4 survivors to two-helper invariant plane curves. HC4MYIR0/1/2 close multiplier-zero images in all helper counts and every admitted two-helper overlap in every stable dimension; the complete admitted HC4 overlap family is now closed. IS0/1/2 identify the full JC2 content of an unconditional residual-free extension, including an exact source-correlated class lattice and actual unit-Hessian embeddings with an always invertible constructed gradient. IT0/1/2 give intrinsic finite-energy and inverse-Hessian certificates and a mixed three-direction criterion before any ambient output construction. IU0/1/2 exploit actual free projections and the zero-section first jet, closing critical-value traces and testing the global immersion obligation in a universal noncritical construction. IV0/1/2 separate complete compensation identities from codimension-one source recovery and provide a canonical Legendre-hypersurface normality gate. IW0/1/2 close every constant trace through an infinite-order integral middle-cycle obstruction, with arbitrary helper degrees. IX0/1/2 separate arbitrary quadric plane classes from actual radical-curve recovery and close coordinate-composite or smooth/nonparametric descended nonconstant traces. IY0/1/2 close contractible full-preimage curves and descended cusps, and impose the exact generic-pencil boundary-defect certificate on the remaining multibranch cases. IZ0/1/2 match the intrinsic generic genus on all one-place zero curves and close every rank-one descended trace, including all internally multibranch cases and positive-power rational descent. JA0/1/2 force the actual disjoint extra-prime/unit/boundary configuration and bound its one-place part; scalar extra units close the selected one-place case.
lessons_before.avoid: Treating the old parameter extension statement as already allowing new algebraic coefficients; identifying coefficient parameters with original source g; applying plane nonproperness on a parameter-cover source; losing vertical components without checking dominance; counting rows by total degree; confusing multivariable gcd one with comaximality; dropping the generic positive filtration or exact content hypotheses; inferring full splitting groups.
lessons_before.boundary: HC4MYIO0 permits arbitrary independent coefficient fields D/C(T): every positive-degree P in D[Z] has P+g irreducible over Frac(L tensor_C(T) D), including algebraic coefficients themselves. Original-source inertia is lifted on an algebraic parameter cover, outer critical images give integral critical values, and the norm theorem handles their monic models. Finite coefficient-algebra specialization then gives arbitrary independent fields. HC4MYIO1 applies this on multiplier-component function fields: arbitrary overlap of the X coefficients in P(T,X,Z) has zero generic source-fixed class group if a positive Z direction survives on each geometric factor of A(T,X). Distinct rows may have different component counts. HC4MYIO2 closes these carried outputs when every full content-level polynomial P(c,X,Z) is nonconstant closed and a positive generic filtration is certified. No common global free filtration is required. Monic root terms with arbitrary overlapping lower coefficients, and the broader polynomial Bezout leading family P=a(X)b(Z)+Q with u A+v a=1 over C(T)[X] and deg_Z Q<deg_Z b, have uniform generic filtrations in every degree. Gcd one in several X variables alone does not imply that identity, and failure of this sufficient certificate does not exclude other filtrations. Overlap alone is no longer an escape in these admitted families. Residual-direction failures, overlaps with no verified positive generic filtration, nonconstant composite content levels, other geometries and arbitrary-graph observable existence remain distinct. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIP0 replaces positive generic filtrations by one F-locally nilpotent derivation moving the image equation, under faithful flatness, geometric height-one integrality and principal normal geometric generic image components. Its degree-zero kernel may be large and filtered pieces infinite-dimensional. A moved affine-space component first forces all generic units scalar; the two-sided quotient-unit argument then makes the pairwise component multipliers scalar and supplies the common pencil. No generic scalar-unit hypothesis is needed. HC4MYIP1 forces every nonautomorphic image equation into the kernels of all relative additive actions; a family with joint kernel F, in particular trivial relative Makar-Limanov invariant, forces the inverse without any generic or global positive filtration. HC4MYIP2 applies the natural polynomial-direction actions to every overlap satisfying the residual-direction and exact full content hypotheses. All surviving image equations must belong to F[X]; primitive multiplier content further gives the actual global equation in C[T,V,X]. These are uniform necessary image conditions, not existence or rectification results. The induced source actions fix the original two source coordinates and move only stable variables. Missing generic filtrations alone no longer permit a noninvariant image in this family. Additive-invariant images, composite content levels, other observables and actual endpoint representatives remain distinct. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. In the general IP0/1 criterion the geometric generic ring is explicitly a normal domain; the overlap application already proves this by primitive linearity. HC4MYIQ0 applies rank-two descent directly to any transcendental h0 with generic image equation E=Q(h0): the global smooth derivative makes Q linear and the source helper rational over F, without a generic filtration or an original global helper equation. That label conclusion still requires a separate field argument. HC4MYIQ1 supplies it for every one-multiplier-variable overlap (T,M(T,X)Y-P(T,X,Z)) with a surviving polynomial Z direction on each generic multiplier row and exact nonconstant closed content levels, for all q>=1,r>=q and all degrees. No primitive-content, monic/Bezout, generic-filtration or forgetful-flatness hypothesis remains; admitted content levels may depend only on X. A nonzero substituted multiplier eliminates Y. A zero substituted multiplier puts the helper in C(T), and retained polynomial-output irreducibility makes the source base change a domain; a finite self tensor is a domain only at degree one. Thus both cases force the original Keller field degree one. HC4MYIQ2 reduces every admitted HC4 overlap survivor to exactly two multiplier variables, one root variable and no unused variables. Its image remains additive-invariant in F[X1,X2], globally C[T,V,X1,X2] for primitive content, and cannot be a nontrivial univariate polynomial composition. One-helper invariant images are no longer a frontier in this family. Two-helper invariant plane curves, residual-direction failures, composite content levels, other observables and actual endpoint representatives remain distinct. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIR0 closes actual source images contained in the multiplier divisor for every helper count under the generic residual polynomial-direction hypothesis alone: the full parameter action fixes the selected row, and source within-row transitivity makes its component target-fixed. HC4MYIR1 closes every two-helper overlap with the retained residual and exact full closed-content hypotheses for all q>=1,r>=q+1 and all degrees. The coefficient-drop set in the helper plane is finite and its generic fibres are empty; all other nonempty fibres have expected dimension, proving generic forgetful flatness without faithfulness. Flat pullback excludes hidden curve components. lessons_before.use: For W=D^G, keep every conjugate h-valuation, construct branch selectors and average only after suppressing the other branches. The residue field of W is the fixed field of the valuation stabilizer H, whose residue action is faithful in characteristic zero. Thus the classical residue extension must be Galois, even if G has h poles. Generic indices are |G| and the selected completed index is |H|; the index loss counts the other branches. Long has a non-Galois cubic residue extension with trivial deck group, so it admits no such direct finite quotient. Its completed automorphism group is trivial. lessons_before.title: Use both affine-space quotient unit groups to turn a moved additive action into a pencil, or force an invariant image
lessons_before.when: A generic positive filtration is missing but the observable fibre carries relative locally nilpotent derivations.
lessons_before.use: An F-defined locally nilpotent derivation gives equal additive degrees on conjugate principal image components. If it moves their product, the common degree is positive, and any generic unit must be scalar by restriction to one affine-space component. The first component relation makes its multiplier degree zero; restriction to the opposite component and the same degree contradiction make it scalar. This supplies the common generic pencil without a scalar degree-zero kernel or finite filtered pieces. Rank-two reflexive descent gives the inverse. Thus nonautomorphic images are fixed by every relative additive action; joint kernel F suffices to close them. For overlapping polynomial-direction outputs the natural actions have exact joint kernel F[X], and primitive content descends this globally to C[T,V,X]. HC4MYIQ0/1/2 descend any univariate generic helper, close every one-helper admitted overlap including nonprimitive content, and reduce HC4 survivors to two-helper invariant plane curves. HC4MYIR0/1/2 close multiplier-zero images in all helper counts and every admitted two-helper overlap in every stable dimension; the complete admitted HC4 overlap family is now closed. IS0/1/2 identify the full JC2 content of an unconditional residual-free extension, including an exact source-correlated class lattice and actual unit-Hessian embeddings with an always invertible constructed gradient. IT0/1/2 give intrinsic finite-energy and inverse-Hessian certificates and a mixed three-direction criterion before any ambient output construction. IU0/1/2 exploit actual free projections and the zero-section first jet, closing critical-value traces and testing the global immersion obligation in a universal noncritical construction. IV0/1/2 separate complete compensation identities from codimension-one source recovery and provide a canonical Legendre-hypersurface normality gate. IW0/1/2 close every constant trace through an infinite-order integral middle-cycle obstruction, with arbitrary helper degrees. IX0/1/2 separate arbitrary quadric plane classes from actual radical-curve recovery and close coordinate-composite or smooth/nonparametric descended nonconstant traces. IY0/1/2 close contractible full-preimage curves and descended cusps, and impose the exact generic-pencil boundary-defect certificate on the remaining multibranch cases. IZ0/1/2 match the intrinsic generic genus on all one-place zero curves and close every rank-one descended trace, including all internally multibranch cases and positive-power rational descent. JA0/1/2 force the actual disjoint extra-prime/unit/boundary configuration and bound its one-place part; scalar extra units close the selected one-place case.
lessons_before.avoid: Using only one component quotient; assuming a degree-zero kernel is scalar; substituting arbitrary derivations for locally nilpotent ones; requiring generic units scalar when the moved-component argument proves it; declaring a stationary image nonautomorphic; identifying the natural kernel with the full Makar-Limanov invariant; dropping the primitive-content qualification for global target-helper descent; assuming induced stable actions are linearizable.
lessons_before.boundary: HC4MYIP0 replaces positive generic filtrations by one F-locally nilpotent derivation moving the image equation, under faithful flatness, geometric height-one integrality and principal normal geometric generic image components. Its degree-zero kernel may be large and filtered pieces infinite-dimensional. A moved affine-space component first forces all generic units scalar; the two-sided quotient-unit argument then makes the pairwise component multipliers scalar and supplies the common pencil. No generic scalar-unit hypothesis is needed. HC4MYIP1 forces every nonautomorphic image equation into the kernels of all relative additive actions; a family with joint kernel F, in particular trivial relative Makar-Limanov invariant, forces the inverse without any generic or global positive filtration. HC4MYIP2 applies the natural polynomial-direction actions to every overlap satisfying the residual-direction and exact full content hypotheses. All surviving image equations must belong to F[X]; primitive multiplier content further gives the actual global equation in C[T,V,X]. These are uniform necessary image conditions, not existence or rectification results. The induced source actions fix the original two source coordinates and move only stable variables. Missing generic filtrations alone no longer permit a noninvariant image in this family. Additive-invariant images, composite content levels, other observables and actual endpoint representatives remain distinct. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. In the general IP0/1 criterion the geometric generic ring is explicitly a normal domain; the overlap application already proves this by primitive linearity. HC4MYIQ0 applies rank-two descent directly to any transcendental h0 with generic image equation E=Q(h0): the global smooth derivative makes Q linear and the source helper rational over F, without a generic filtration or an original global helper equation. That label conclusion still requires a separate field argument. HC4MYIQ1 supplies it for every one-multiplier-variable overlap (T,M(T,X)Y-P(T,X,Z)) with a surviving polynomial Z direction on each generic multiplier row and exact nonconstant closed content levels, for all q>=1,r>=q and all degrees. No primitive-content, monic/Bezout, generic-filtration or forgetful-flatness hypothesis remains; admitted content levels may depend only on X. A nonzero substituted multiplier eliminates Y. A zero substituted multiplier puts the helper in C(T), and retained polynomial-output irreducibility makes the source base change a domain; a finite self tensor is a domain only at degree one. Thus both cases force the original Keller field degree one. HC4MYIQ2 reduces every admitted HC4 overlap survivor to exactly two multiplier variables, one root variable and no unused variables. Its image remains additive-invariant in F[X1,X2], globally C[T,V,X1,X2] for primitive content, and cannot be a nontrivial univariate polynomial composition. One-helper invariant images are no longer a frontier in this family. Two-helper invariant plane curves, residual-direction failures, composite content levels, other observables and actual endpoint representatives remain distinct. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIR0 closes actual source images contained in the multiplier divisor for every helper count under the generic residual polynomial-direction hypothesis alone: the full parameter action fixes the selected row, and source within-row transitivity makes its component target-fixed. HC4MYIR1 closes every two-helper overlap with the retained residual and exact full closed-content hypotheses for all q>=1,r>=q+1 and all degrees. The coefficient-drop set in the helper plane is finite and its generic fibres are empty; all other nonempty fibres have expected dimension, proving generic forgetful flatness without faithfulness. Flat pullback excludes hidden curve components. A nonconstant line in each source affine space is finite surjective onto its helper curve by an elementary integrality argument, and curve units are scalar. Actual source disjointness therefore makes the helper curves disjoint; ordinary helper-plane degree descends a pencil of outer degree [L:F], and IQ0 forces degree one. No curve or action classification, generic ambient filtration, primitive content, monic/Bezout certificate or stable cancellation is needed. HC4MYIR2 closes the complete admitted HC4 polynomial-direction overlap family: p+q+u=3 leaves only one-helper cases and the now closed two-helper one-root case. The former IQ2 invariant plane-curve residual is no longer open inside this family. This does not supply a universal graph normal form or compatible observables. Residual-direction failures, nonconstant composite content levels, other output geometries, actual endpoint representatives, both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. Three or more helpers in larger stable dimensions remain separate. HC4MYIS0/1/2 give a sharp universal boundary for dropping the residual polynomial direction. Every plane Keller pair K=(f,g) has the actual closed HC4-size graph j=(f(s,t),s,t,u,v) carrying it through (T,(f(X)-T)Y+g(X)), with primitive multiplier content and smooth geometrically integral fibres over every target point, hence global faithful flatness. With d=[C(s,t):C(f,g)], its smooth normal geometric generic ambient ring has scalar units and exact class lattice Z^d/Z(1,...,1). The source stabilizer fixes a selected component class, nonzero of infinite order when d>1; source-fixed class vanishing is equivalent to d=1. The helper map has dimension-jumping full fibres over the actual d source points and is not flat. The same literal graph has actual unit Hessian for Q=T^2/2+X1Y+X2Z, and transfers to the fixed Meng-Yang potential through HM0. Its constructed gradient always has an explicit polynomial inverse; the arbitrary carried pair is not the intrinsic pair of a nonautomorphic HC4 gradient. Thus discarding the residual hypothesis from the universal carried-inverse criterion, even with these good target fibres, primitive content, scalar units, actual closed embedding and actual unit Hessian, is equivalent to JC2. This is an open-assertion equivalence and a source-correlated class obstruction, not a proof that the inverse or class vanishing holds. Extra compatibility with intrinsic HC4 data, composite content levels, actual endpoint representatives, both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIT0 proves by a field-norm argument that every locally finite constant Nambu direction of a complex Keller map is locally nilpotent; one nonzero such direction forces a plane Keller inverse. HC4MYIT1 uses the actual Legendre energy G=x dot grad h-h: its single-direction finite orbit is equivalent to local nilpotence on the entire source ring. Under hypothetical HC4 nonautomorphy the finite-direction space is exactly W^perp for Tang's unique affine plane, hence has dimension two; an automorphic gradient has all four directions. A third independent finite-energy direction, or one finite direction with nonzero inverse-Hessian square, forces the inverse. HC4MYIT2 shows that the exact constant inverse-Hessian zero cone must equal that same linear two-plane under nonautomorphy; any other cone shape forces the inverse. Zero-square directions give explicit polynomial quasi-translations. Pure whole Hodge traces and finite-energy directions may be mixed in a rank-three certificate. A linear two-plane cone also occurs for an explicitly automorphic quartic-base control and is not a converse. These intrinsic all-degree criteria need no ambient observables or generic class vanishing. No extra finite direction or recurrence is automatic; finite derivative prefixes do not prove termination. The linear-plane residual, compatible arbitrary intrinsic observables, actual endpoint representatives, both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. Any supplied linear two-plane contained in Z_h reconstructs an actual cotangent form without assuming nonautomorphy or invoking Tang: constant source coordinates make the upper-left inverse-Hessian block zero; its cross-block determinant is a unit, and block inversion makes the complementary actual Hessian block zero. Thus h=D(z)+w dot K(z), with D=h(z,0), K_i=partial_(w_i)h(z,0) and J(K) a nonzero constant. The remaining exact-plane case has a directly recoverable intrinsic Keller pair rather than a need for longer derivative prefixes. HC4MYIU0 classifies constant-trace zero-sections for actual closed embeddings retaining two ambient free projections: rank-three helper quadrics and nonzero rank-two levels cannot be affine planes; the remaining zero-sections are reduced plane components with an actual source coordinate pair. HC4MYIU1 closes every such embedding of the intrinsic potential lambda+w dot K when the base trace is the ambient critical value lambda. The rank-two first free jet is injective on a coordinate line, while the rank-one jet is already a coordinate pair. All helper degrees and nonlinear free-variable dependence are unrestricted; no fibre-affine or generic-action hypothesis is needed. Constant invertible free frames with arbitrary polynomial base offsets are admitted when their literal trace is lambda. A different constant trace leaves only a noncritical rank-one helper plane and explicit normal first-jet corrections; that full chart remains open. HC4MYIU2 checks a universal compensation in this residual: it has unit Hessian for every normalized plane Keller input and an embedded zero-section, but global immersion already forces the inverse by a two-dimensional spectral argument and a directly proved plane nilpotent-Jacobian lemma using the retained generative input. A genuine automorphic input explicitly fails immersion, so these are not embedding converses. Arbitrary ambient translations are not assumed to preserve unit Hessian or realize arbitrary intrinsic target shifts. The remaining noncritical rank-one embeddings, arbitrary intrinsic projection data, actual endpoint representatives, both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIV0 gives the complete all-degree noncritical compensation H=w dot A, X=c+H, (Y,Z)=K-(2c+H)A+(w2,-w1)C and its exact gauge freedom. Its zero-section coordinate obligation is not global source recovery. HC4MYIV1 reproduces the characteristic-zero weak-type-one mechanism of Borisov-Gabber-Vasiu and derives primitive-helper normality and codimension-one recovery gates. lessons_before.title: Prove helper flatness and finite-line curve surjectivity before descending the disjoint source pencil
lessons_before.when: A carried stable image in a polynomial-direction overlap is invariant in two multiplier helpers, under the residual and exact full closed-content hypotheses.
lessons_before.use: Check multiplier-zero images first using parameter-row descent and within-row transitivity. Otherwise the finite coefficient-drop set has empty generic fibres, so expected dimensions and retained miracle flatness prove the helper projection flat. Flat pullback to each helper curve embeds into its polynomial generic fibre and excludes hidden components and nilpotents. Actual source components map dominantly to those curves. Restrict a coordinate to a nonconstant source line: its parameter is integral over the curve algebra, so the line is finite surjective, even for a singular curve. Polynomial source units make curve units scalar. Actual source disjointness makes the helper curves disjoint; ordinary polynomial degree gives a common descended pencil whose outer degree equals the full source-field degree. IQ0 makes it one. This closes every admitted two-helper overlap in every stable dimension, and with IQ1 the complete admitted HC4 overlap family, in all degrees. IS0/1/2 identify the full JC2 content of an unconditional residual-free extension, including an exact source-correlated class lattice and actual unit-Hessian embeddings with an always invertible constructed gradient. IT0/1/2 give intrinsic finite-energy and inverse-Hessian certificates and a mixed three-direction criterion before any ambient output construction. IU0/1/2 exploit actual free projections and the zero-section first jet, closing critical-value traces and testing the global immersion obligation in a universal noncritical construction. lessons_before.title: Use the canonical source-correlated modification to audit residual-free inverse claims before pursuing coefficients
lessons_before.when: A proposed extension drops the surviving root direction from the admitted overlap theorem and replaces it with good global fibres, primitive content, scalar units or actual unit Hessian.
lessons_before.use: Insert an arbitrary plane Keller pair into M=f(X)-T,V=M Y+g(X) with the graph (f,s,t,u,v). Its actual closed image and smooth integral fibres everywhere do not need an inverse. The exact geometric class lattice is Z^d modulo the diagonal, where d is the original Keller field degree. The source stabilizer fixes its selected component class; it has infinite order when d>1. Thus canonical source-fixed class vanishing is equivalent to JC2. The graph also pulls Q back to f^2/2+su+tv with determinant-one Hessian and an explicit gradient inverse, and transfers to the fixed Meng-Yang potential. This checks that a merely carried pair is not automatically the intrinsic pair of a nonautomorphic gradient. Focus a broader theorem on the source-correlated class obstruction or on that additional intrinsic compatibility, rather than on degree or smoothness refinements. IT0/1/2 give intrinsic finite-energy and inverse-Hessian certificates and a mixed three-direction criterion before any ambient output construction. IU0/1/2 exploit actual free projections and the zero-section first jet, closing critical-value traces and testing the global immersion obligation in a universal noncritical construction. IV0/1/2 separate complete compensation identities from codimension-one source recovery and provide a canonical Legendre-hypersurface normality gate. IW0/1/2 close every constant trace through an infinite-order integral middle-cycle obstruction, with arbitrary helper degrees. IX0/1/2 separate arbitrary quadric plane classes from actual radical-curve recovery and close coordinate-composite or smooth/nonparametric descended nonconstant traces. IY0/1/2 close contractible full-preimage curves and descended cusps, and impose the exact generic-pencil boundary-defect certificate on the remaining multibranch cases. IZ0/1/2 match the intrinsic generic genus on all one-place zero curves and close every rank-one descended trace, including all internally multibranch cases and positive-power rational descent. JA0/1/2 force the actual disjoint extra-prime/unit/boundary configuration and bound its one-place part; scalar extra units close the selected one-place case.
lessons_before.avoid: Assuming good global fibres imply zero source-fixed generic classes; localizing away the selected multiplier-zero image; inferring principality of individual geometric components from the smooth global equation; treating a conditional degree-three permutation lattice as a nonautomorphic Keller example; equating an arbitrary carried pair with intrinsic HC4 gradient data; claiming JC2 from the equivalence.
lessons_before.boundary: HC4MYIS0/1/2 give a sharp universal boundary for dropping the residual polynomial direction. Every plane Keller pair K=(f,g) has the actual closed HC4-size graph j=(f(s,t),s,t,u,v) carrying it through (T,(f(X)-T)Y+g(X)), with primitive multiplier content and smooth geometrically integral fibres over every target point, hence global faithful flatness. With d=[C(s,t):C(f,g)], its smooth normal geometric generic ambient ring has scalar units and exact class lattice Z^d/Z(1,...,1). The source stabilizer fixes a selected component class, nonzero of infinite order when d>1; source-fixed class vanishing is equivalent to d=1. The helper map has dimension-jumping full fibres over the actual d source points and is not flat. The same literal graph has actual unit Hessian for Q=T^2/2+X1Y+X2Z, and transfers to the fixed Meng-Yang potential through HM0. Its constructed gradient always has an explicit polynomial inverse; the arbitrary carried pair is not the intrinsic pair of a nonautomorphic HC4 gradient. Thus discarding the residual hypothesis from the universal carried-inverse criterion, even with these good target fibres, primitive content, scalar units, actual closed embedding and actual unit Hessian, is equivalent to JC2. This is an open-assertion equivalence and a source-correlated class obstruction, not a proof that the inverse or class vanishing holds. Extra compatibility with intrinsic HC4 data, composite content levels, actual endpoint representatives, both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIT0 proves by a field-norm argument that every locally finite constant Nambu direction of a complex Keller map is locally nilpotent; one nonzero such direction forces a plane Keller inverse. HC4MYIT1 uses the actual Legendre energy G=x dot grad h-h: its single-direction finite orbit is equivalent to local nilpotence on the entire source ring. Under hypothetical HC4 nonautomorphy the finite-direction space is exactly W^perp for Tang's unique affine plane, hence has dimension two; an automorphic gradient has all four directions. A third independent finite-energy direction, or one finite direction with nonzero inverse-Hessian square, forces the inverse. HC4MYIT2 shows that the exact constant inverse-Hessian zero cone must equal that same linear two-plane under nonautomorphy; any other cone shape forces the inverse. Zero-square directions give explicit polynomial quasi-translations. Pure whole Hodge traces and finite-energy directions may be mixed in a rank-three certificate. A linear two-plane cone also occurs for an explicitly automorphic quartic-base control and is not a converse. These intrinsic all-degree criteria need no ambient observables or generic class vanishing. No extra finite direction or recurrence is automatic; finite derivative prefixes do not prove termination. The linear-plane residual, compatible arbitrary intrinsic observables, actual endpoint representatives, both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. Any supplied linear two-plane contained in Z_h reconstructs an actual cotangent form without assuming nonautomorphy or invoking Tang: constant source coordinates make the upper-left inverse-Hessian block zero; its cross-block determinant is a unit, and block inversion makes the complementary actual Hessian block zero. Thus h=D(z)+w dot K(z), with D=h(z,0), K_i=partial_(w_i)h(z,0) and J(K) a nonzero constant. The remaining exact-plane case has a directly recoverable intrinsic Keller pair rather than a need for longer derivative prefixes. HC4MYIU1 closes every such embedding of the intrinsic potential lambda+w dot K when the base trace is the ambient critical value lambda. A genuine automorphic input explicitly fails immersion, so these are not embedding converses. Arbitrary ambient translations are not assumed to preserve unit Hessian or realize arbitrary intrinsic target shifts. The remaining noncritical rank-one embeddings, arbitrary intrinsic projection data, actual endpoint representatives, both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. lessons_before.title: Use the actual energy and inverse-Hessian cone to certify intrinsic directions before attempting ambient observables
lessons_before.when: An actual complex HC4 potential has unit Hessian, with arbitrary graph shape or polynomial degree, and an intrinsic direction can be certified by an exact recurrence, zero-square identity or whole pure trace.
lessons_before.use: Construct the polynomial Nambu derivations from the actual inverse Hessian and G=x dot grad h-h. Commuting derivatives recover every source coordinate from G, so a finite energy orbit tests local finiteness on the whole source ring. A field norm excludes nonzero eigenvalues, making local finiteness nilpotence. Tang and the one-direction plane slice argument show that a nonautomorphic HC4 potential has exactly a two-dimensional finite-direction space W^perp. Its inverse-Hessian zero cone and pure whole-trace covectors give the same plane. Three independent certificates of any mixture, one finite direction with nonzero square, or an exact zero cone of any other shape force the gradient inverse. A zero-square direction also gives its explicit polynomial quasi-translation. IU0/1/2 exploit actual free projections and the zero-section first jet, closing critical-value traces and testing the global immersion obligation in a universal noncritical construction. IV0/1/2 separate complete compensation identities from codimension-one source recovery and provide a canonical Legendre-hypersurface normality gate. IW0/1/2 close every constant trace through an infinite-order integral middle-cycle obstruction, with arbitrary helper degrees. IX0/1/2 separate arbitrary quadric plane classes from actual radical-curve recovery and close coordinate-composite or smooth/nonparametric descended nonconstant traces. IY0/1/2 close contractible full-preimage curves and descended cusps, and impose the exact generic-pencil boundary-defect certificate on the remaining multibranch cases. IZ0/1/2 match the intrinsic generic genus on all one-place zero curves and close every rank-one descended trace, including all internally multibranch cases and positive-power rational descent. JA0/1/2 force the actual disjoint extra-prime/unit/boundary configuration and bound its one-place part; scalar extra units close the selected one-place case.
lessons_before.avoid: Replacing an exact recurrence by a bounded derivative prefix; asserting every intrinsic direction finite; confusing a polynomial slice with local nilpotence; applying the one-direction inverse theorem in arbitrary dimensions; treating a plane-shaped inverse-Hessian cone as sufficient for nonautomorphy; transferring Hessians through nonlinear source changes; importing a general action classification or an automatic ambient LND lift.
lessons_before.boundary: HC4MYIT0 proves by a field-norm argument that every locally finite constant Nambu direction of a complex Keller map is locally nilpotent; one nonzero such direction forces a plane Keller inverse. HC4MYIT1 uses the actual Legendre energy G=x dot grad h-h: its single-direction finite orbit is equivalent to local nilpotence on the entire source ring. Under hypothetical HC4 nonautomorphy the finite-direction space is exactly W^perp for Tang's unique affine plane, hence has dimension two; an automorphic gradient has all four directions. A third independent finite-energy direction, or one finite direction with nonzero inverse-Hessian square, forces the inverse. HC4MYIT2 shows that the exact constant inverse-Hessian zero cone must equal that same linear two-plane under nonautomorphy; any other cone shape forces the inverse. Zero-square directions give explicit polynomial quasi-translations. Pure whole Hodge traces and finite-energy directions may be mixed in a rank-three certificate. A linear two-plane cone also occurs for an explicitly automorphic quartic-base control and is not a converse. These intrinsic all-degree criteria need no ambient observables or generic class vanishing. No extra finite direction or recurrence is automatic; finite derivative prefixes do not prove termination. Any supplied linear two-plane contained in Z_h reconstructs an actual cotangent form without assuming nonautomorphy or invoking Tang: constant source coordinates make the upper-left inverse-Hessian block zero; its cross-block determinant is a unit, and block inversion makes the complementary actual Hessian block zero. Thus h=D(z)+w dot K(z), with D=h(z,0), K_i=partial_(w_i)h(z,0) and J(K) a nonzero constant. The remaining exact-plane case has a directly recoverable intrinsic Keller pair rather than a need for longer derivative prefixes. lessons_before.title: Use integral projectivity and rigidity before changing a quantum graph lattice
lessons_before.when: A finite-left flat full quantum graph carrier or a rational full Weyl action is being proposed, especially as a repair of a nonfree or escaping-boundary model.
lessons_before.use: Require all Weyl relations and the identified free rank-one special graph. Generic projectivity plus central-fiber Ext gluing gives projectivity over K[[t]] and an actual finite idempotent. Three elementary block factors and one zero stabilization normalize its special idempotent to e11. For a fixed rational full action, compare full finite lattices through their intersection; finite left torsion bimodules vanish by Bernstein inequality. Rank-one sub-quantum graph errors are scalar and can be removed in finitely many steps. A least central shift between two integral graph models induces a polynomial f whose logarithmic Hamiltonian derivatives are polynomial; the full frame forces f constant and bounded central torsion kills the cokernel. Thus the models are centrally homothetic for all parameter orders. Use QPG1 central patching after proving generic finite projectivity and an admitted C-frame; if the generic module is rank-one free, its integral frame follows automatically. For generic rank-one full actions, QVA1 now supplies C-admission from Gauss-regularity and the intended shadow; it need not be assumed separately.
lessons_before.avoid: Trying successive finite lattice modifications to free a generic nonfree carrier while preserving its rational full action. Do not infer freeness from integral projectivity, promote formal intertwiners to rational ones, apply scalar correction to a higher-rank special module, or invoke the uniqueness theorem for only part of the right Weyl action.
lessons_before.boundary: A normalized finite corner certificate is now equivalent to finite-carrier existence, but its size and spatial degrees remain unbounded and no Long certificate is constructed. Generic lattice uniqueness allows any finite division rank; integral homothety uses the free rank-one symplectic special graph. The generic projectivity input is the stated recent preprint lemma. Exact controls establish elementary matrix identities and positive graph actions, not independent replay of the universal theorems. QNI1 formal comparisons remain outside fixed rational-action rigidity. QPF1 nonfree left models still lack a constructed full right action. QTC1 also makes the carrier an integral projective generator by its trace ideal. This gives Morita evaluation over its full endomorphism algebra, not over the potentially smaller source image. Tensoring with the dual over that source instead has a nonfinite off-diagonal classical boundary for every noninvertible symplectic map. Fixed-action lattice rigidity does not turn this reverse tensor into a finite carrier. QRA1 adds inverse-pole removal for any R-flat lattice when the special coordinate map is injective. An injective nonsurjective special map cannot become a unit in its actual generic endomorphism algebra. Exact factorization Y=XW plus the stated full Weyl relations forces such a unit in every finite generic rank. This does not infer a generic inverse from a special one, or exclude quantum deformations which break the exact factorization. QFR1 uses finite-jet free frames of a specified rank-three special module. QUR1 excludes that single physical normalization at every parameter order: completed repolarization makes it a rank-two connection and a regular-sequence moving-zero argument controls all lower mixing. This is not higher-rank lattice homothety or a constructed Long graph. QPG1 constructs the integral carrier from exact generic/formal patching data rather than assuming a finite lattice. Its rank-one unit calculation also proves generic freeness plus formal freeness implies integral freeness. Completed division comparison is weaker than an admitted C-frame. This does not contradict fixed-action lattice uniqueness: a new action or its admitted patching data must first be supplied. QVA1 extends scalar sub-quantum correction to a saturated initial ideal before a free special frame is known: (J:J)=S, gcd normalization and a full Hamiltonian residue frame make that initial ideal principal. Hence a finite generic rank-one Gauss-regular action automatically has the formal frame for QPG1 patching. This is formal freeness, not generic freeness or a higher-multiplicity statement.
lessons_before.reopen_when: An actual Long normalized finite corner is constructed, a universal obstruction excludes all such corners, or a new full rational action provides a scalar free frame. A lattice change alone in a fixed action is not a new admission route.
