lessons_before.title: Compose full graph corners while checking the side of dual finiteness
lessons_before.when: A proposed new quantum action is assembled from finite carriers, duals, self-correspondences or normal-closure constructions.
lessons_before.use: For forward composition, apply the first right corner homomorphism to every entry of the second idempotent and right matrices. This produces a normalized finite corner of product size and degree bound. Track generic left and right indices and completed degrees by their separate multiplicative tower laws. A finite carrier is an integral projective generator, but its target dual is finite on the opposite target side. Before source-balanced reverse composition, reduce it to the classical fiber product. Its evaluation kernel reduces to the off-diagonal part. For a noninvertible characteristic-zero etale map of affine space this part is not finite over the source. Long exposes the boundary explicitly by w^2=Q and second-point admission w inverse.
lessons_before.avoid: Treating finite left and finite right as interchangeable; using Morita evaluation over the source image without proving it equals the full endomorphism algebra; promoting a division tensor bimodule to a Galois closure algebra; inferring failure of the original carrier from a nonfinite reverse composition; or inferring generic nonfiniteness solely from a nonfinite special fiber.
lessons_before.boundary: The universal self-product equivalence uses external fpqc descent, purity and characteristic-zero affine-space covering theory. The explicit Long localization and integrality argument are independent of the global covering theorem. Its actual etale off-diagonal cover differs from the finite ramified normalization. First-order Hochschild/Witt lifting and bounded prime degree do not give an all-order bounded realization or prescribe arithmetic support. No new Long full action or finite corner is constructed. The actual QNI1 k-fold iterates give generic indices3^k, completed degree1 and forward degree at most12^k in every rank at least three, with arbitrary identity contact and formal innerness at contact order at least two. No rank-two example or bound independent of k is inferred.
lessons_before.reopen_when: A new normalized finite Long corner is constructed, an all-degree obstruction excludes every such corner, or a genuinely different reverse/closure construction supplies its missing finite admission.

lessons_before.title: Test primitive helper recovery on source divisors and use the canonical Legendre hypersurface
lessons_before.when: A proposed embedding construction has a primitive polynomial field helper, a candidate normal implicit image, or complete noncritical compensation data with only generic source recovery.
lessons_before.use: Write the primitive implicit equation q(T,S) and pull back p=q_S. Polynomial Nambu differentiation makes the entire hypersurface singular ideal equal to (p) on the source. Target descent of p or one positive power forces the inverse. Under nonautomorphy p has an actual singular-preimage divisor, so normality or local embedding in source codimension one is enough to close the map. This reproduces the characteristic-zero weak-type-one mechanism with attribution. For a gradient, use G=x dot grad h-h: its actual derivative identity proves primitivity. Normality of the different Legendre hypersurface is equivalent to a gradient inverse, and its linear equation gives the inverse explicitly. Conditional cotangent nonautomorphy has collision lines on generic stable fibres. Keep full compensation identities and gauge freedom separate from this global recovery obligation. IW0/1/2 close every constant trace through an infinite-order integral middle-cycle obstruction, with arbitrary helper degrees. IX0/1/2 separate arbitrary quadric plane classes from actual radical-curve recovery and close coordinate-composite or smooth/nonparametric descended nonconstant traces. IY0/1/2 close contractible full-preimage curves and descended cusps, and impose the exact generic-pencil boundary-defect certificate on the remaining multibranch cases. IZ0/1/2 match the intrinsic generic genus on all one-place zero curves and close every rank-one descended trace, including all internally multibranch cases and positive-power rational descent. JA0/1/2 force the actual disjoint extra-prime/unit/boundary configuration and bound its one-place part; scalar extra units close the selected one-place case.
lessons_before.avoid: Confusing field primitivity with source algebra generation; replacing a locally closed embedding by injective differential; moving all primitive-helper singularities to a missing boundary; transferring normality from the actual HC4 image to the Legendre image; substituting union saturation for componentwise saturation; claiming a formal quadratic-preserving shear is an ambient automorphism; importing positive-characteristic statements from the recent source.
lessons_before.boundary: HC4MYIV0 gives the complete all-degree noncritical compensation H=w dot A, X=c+H, (Y,Z)=K-(2c+H)A+(w2,-w1)C and its exact gauge freedom. Its zero-section coordinate obligation is not global source recovery. HC4MYIV1 reproduces the characteristic-zero weak-type-one mechanism of Borisov-Gabber-Vasiu and derives primitive-helper normality and codimension-one recovery gates. For a primitive polynomial field helper a, the implicit derivative p=q_S(F,a) generates the pullback hypersurface singular ideal. Target descent of p or a positive power forces the Keller inverse; normality, regularity along source prime-divisor images, or local embedding at every source codimension-one point also suffice. Under nonautomorphy an actually reached singular divisor is unavoidable, and at least one component must share its generic target image with another source divisor. HC4MYIV2 uses the actual Legendre energy as the canonical primitive helper, with the Adamus-Hajto primitivity proof reproduced. A Keller gradient is invertible exactly when its Legendre hypersurface is normal; a linear implicit equation gives explicit inverse coordinates. In the hypothetical nonautomorphic HC4 cotangent case, the singular-preimage divisor already consists of collision lines on generic stable source planes, with degree d-1 counted with multiplicity. The actual smooth closed embedding and this different implicit image must not be confused. No normality certificate is automatic, and a primitive field helper is not a source algebra generator. Full noncritical rank-one data, arbitrary intrinsic projections, actual endpoint representatives, both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIW0/1/2 now close the entire noncritical rank-one closed-embedding chart and hence every constant-trace intrinsic free projection, at any constant value. IW0 proves that every positive polynomial section of the smooth affine four-quadric has the same infinite-order integral middle class as its positive zero-section plane: an explicit proper homotopy identifies sections, a two-coordinate rotation swaps the planes, and a compact real S4 pairs with that plane in one transverse point. IW1 compares two principal divisors on the actual integral image intersection. Their cycles give sum of the d generic closed source sections equal to the one zero-section plane, so (d-1)alpha=0 forces d=1 and the Keller inverse. The actual closed embedding supplies the polynomial ambient lift and every multiplicity is one. The integral cycle map and Poincare-duality foundations are explicitly imported standard inputs, not symbolic-checker conclusions. No helper degree or higher free jet remains open within this chart. IW2 combines this with IU0/1 to close every constant trace, including constant affine frames with arbitrary polynomial offsets whenever D-v^T A^(-T)K is any constant. Earlier IU/IV assertions that the full noncritical chart remained open are historical and superseded in this scope by IW1/2. Existence of aligned intrinsic ambient free projections, nonconstant traces, actual endpoint representatives, both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIX0/1/2 advance beyond the closed constant-trace family. IX0 gives explicit actual closed A2 embeddings with every integral middle class on the smooth four-quadric, including zero, using a geometric-series polynomial inverse and an exact multiplicity-m divisor calculation. An arbitrary affine plane cannot replace an IW section, and passing to the total quadric-level family kills that fibre class. IX1 gives actual radical-curve reconstruction for nonconstant rank-one traces: D=f^2, R=C[f,y1,y2], K=y+2f a imply that K on V(f) is a closed immersion. Any actual A1 zero component, including every coordinate-composite f=P(u), forces the inverse through retained plane-line rectification and one-line injectivity, with all helper degrees allowed. IX2 shows that descent of D=f^2 already forces f=a(K). The reduced source and target zero curves are then isomorphic and every target on a=0 has one preimage. Under hypothetical degree greater than one that whole curve lies in the nonproperness set, so every component must be singular with affine normalization A1. Any smooth component or nonparametric component closes; hyperbolas and their powers are covered, while singular cusps remain open. If a(0)=0 the original cotangent potential has exactly one critical point, excluding only its unit-ideal case in this scope. New nonconstant normal traces with no actual A1 component, singular descended parametric curves, higher helper ranks, unaligned intrinsic projections, actual endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIY0/1/2 close the contractible singular-cusp boundary and strengthen the generic-pencil gate. IY0 gives the exact identity nu_s=d nu_t+E for a Keller pencil relation, where nu=2g-2+r and E retains every source puncture mapping to a finite target point with its ramification index. Equal-genus one-puncture pencils force degree one, while positive target nu and source nu below three times it also close because HW0 excludes degree two. IY1 imports the Lin-Zaidenberg classification explicitly from Palka1405.5391v2 Theorem A: independent rectifications of two isomorphic contractible plane curves give matching monomial cusps; complete preimage and square-free pullback give a pencil identity, and the exact one-puncture genus calculation forces the inverse in every degree. No selected branch is substituted for the full inverse image and no arbitrary curve isomorphism is assumed ambient extendible. IY2 applies componentwise to the actual descended radical-curve isomorphism of IX2. Every remaining target component must have an internal multibranch singularity and Euler characteristic at most zero; different-component intersections do not suffice. Singular unibranch cusps previously retained as open in IX2 are now closed in this stated scope. A saturated contractible radical component also closes without global trace descent. Remaining irreducible pencils satisfy the exact defect identity; isomorphic zero curves do not automatically identify their generic invariants. Multibranch descended components failing the pencil certificate, genuinely non-descended unsaturated traces, higher helper ranks, intrinsic ambient projection existence, actual endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYIZ0/1/2 close the entire target-descended rank-one trace family, including every formerly remaining internally multibranch component. IZ0 activates Vistoli one-place compactification and explicitly imports proper-flat Euler constancy and the normalization exact sequence: the generic pencil genus is the intrinsic normalization genus plus the finite normalization deficit, with one puncture. Properness, finite presentation and flatness are verified. Thus isomorphic one-place zero curves have matching generic-pencil invariants even without ambient equivalence. IZ1 combines complete inverse-image support, square-free Keller pullback and IY0 to force degree one over any irreducible one-place curve whose entire preimage is isomorphic to it, allowing nodes and positive normalization genus. IZ2 applies to actual rank-one embeddings whenever any positive power of D belongs to C(K). HW0 makes the normal trace f target-polynomial; IX2 supplies the full radical-curve isomorphism, and under hypothetical failure the target components are A1-normalized, hence one-place. IZ1 closes every such case. There is no descended nodal or other parametric exception and no helper degree bound. A saturated one-place radical component also closes without global descent; any hypothetical remaining one-place component needs another source prime outside the radical curve over its target image. Constant affine frames and polynomial offsets are covered when the transformed trace has positive-power target-field descent. Previous IX/IY descended multibranch frontiers are historical and closed in this scope, with prior evidence bytes retained. Genuinely non-descended unsaturated rank-one traces, higher helper ranks, unaligned intrinsic projections, actual endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYJA0/1/2 make the actual extra-prime frontier explicit. JA0 proves the scheme-theoretic target image equation and exact factor a(K)=f g with the unit ideal (f,g)=R, including normal-trace multiplicities. The open-and-closed etale section makes every extra source prime disjoint from the entire radical curve and gives an elementary Nisnevich square; local excision or a unit modulo f is not a global inverse. JA1 proves that a one-place radical component under hypothetical failure needs a multi-puncture extra component carrying its defining equation p as a nonconstant unit. If every extra component has only scalar units, the inverse follows. The all-one-place alternative would make b(K) a nonlinear composition and contradict the finite critical locus forced by the Keller differential. JA2 bounds the one-place part when the selected component has A1 normalization: including that component there are at most two one-place components, and a second requires all its singularities to be ordinary nodes. Every non-nodal selected component has no one-place extra. The argument explicitly activates the one-place Milnor critical budget; the multi-puncture component still has to occur and has finite-image boundary index at least its normalized degree. Thus an actual nonconstant unit and a finite target approached from infinity are required, not merely an abstract extra prime. The new section and Milnor inputs are explicit. The full w-dependent embedding must still exclude this configuration or force descent/saturation. Genuinely non-descended traces lacking the selected one-place component, higher helper ranks, unaligned intrinsic projections, actual endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. HC4MYJB0 proves that the JA0 quotient automatically extends to B/(a^m)=R/(f^m) in every order, including all multiplicities, with isomorphic completions. lessons_before.title: Compress a quantum defect on a reducing classical fiber block
lessons_before.when: A polynomial matrix classical symbol or finite special module is proposed as a physical Weyl action, especially near a singular spectral fiber.
lessons_before.use: At a point find a reducing idempotent block on which the relevant classical generators act scalarly. Compressed trace kills every first correction commutator, so compute its period on the full PBW Poisson defect. A nonzero period excludes all ordinary formal corrections without a degree bound. Determine the generated obstruction module by polynomial annihilator identities rather than a generic-field calculation. For the monic elliptic pair the class is S/(u,v), period1. An exhaustive negative-weight cocycle decomposition kills every quadratic lower period and excludes quantum order2. At arbitrary quantum order, check a commuting idempotent through the sub-quantum fiber representation before using the persistent-block compressed-trace obstruction. For the single monic module, use QUR1 repolarization instead: regular-sequence syzygies control every commuting lower jet at a moving common zero.
lessons_before.avoid: Inferring all-ramified nonlifting from one first-order obstruction, assuming a classical reducing projector persists when its character coincides with the other nilpotent block, treating localization of a punctual class as global admission, or confusing the physical [v,u]=27h plane with the QRA1 surface model where u,v commute.
lessons_before.boundary: QFR1 retains its all-degree ordinary and order-two finite-copy residue tests and its general persistent-block criterion. For the single monic module QUR1 removes that extra hypothesis and excludes every quantum order through a rank-two regular-sequence argument at a moving zero. Its proof does not automatically extend to arbitrary higher multiplicities or added matrix summands. The scalar forward Long graph remains formally unobstructed.
lessons_before.reopen_when: A genuinely different special module or a higher-multiplicity model has an admitted full action, or a normalized finite corner for the rank-one Long graph is constructed. The single monic module is closed at every parameter order; do not launch a quantum-order ladder.

lessons_before.title: Remove quadratic drift through its pure-phase quotient while retaining its action on multipliers

lessons_before.use: Handle a nonzero constant symbol first:only P0 is pure. At zero constant symbol,use the Laurent-log trace identity and consecutive traces2..n+1;the Vandermonde argument supplies nilpotence and D_bP0. The scalar inverse then controls full safety. For nonzero drift,descend the phase and scalar potential to n-1 variables;derive closedness from the union with the prior quadratic safe locus. Keep drift on multipliers and use the scalar time-degree cutoff,including slope2 for linear phases. The quotient relates minimum dimensions,and DVG1 fixes the cubic minimum operator order at3. The new prime-index identity extends drift annihilation to ALL finite symbols and ALL algebraic formal symbols over fields,and more generally one finitely generated Z-coefficient model,including arbitrary unit multiples on the pure locus. Nonzero drift removes a phase variable;in n3 full binary positivity then closes the ENTIRE pure-to-safe class in every degree.
lessons_before.avoid: Separating quadratic and drift harmonicity from only the first pure equation;assuming trace-square zero implies nilpotence;using a heat identity with nonzero constant symbol outside P0;dropping drift from marked contractions;copying slope1 for linear phases into drift-diffusion;extending the s-degree-one logarithm proof to higher-order operators;retrying any cubic target of total operator order<=2. Do not extend the arithmetic congruence to arbitrary formal coefficients without p-integrality through jet(D-1)p+1. New prime denominators can defeat it. Do not impose literal field drift equations on nonreduced pure schemes:the dual-number nonnilpotent phase has unit drift but D_bP=epsilon. No general arithmetic-model recognizer,unrestricted formal drift theorem or new numerical endpoint.

GVCPRIMEDRIFT20261116 is an all-order FIELD theorem in the stated coefficient class;GVCSMOOTHTERNARY20261116 gives full positive n3 GVC only for NONZERO linear symbol in that class. GVCNILDRIFTBOUNDARY20261116 preserves nilpotent thickening:finite-order universal drift constraints are radical consequences with some finite power/prefix,but are not ordinary pure-ideal members in general. For n4 take T=partial_s+(4partial_xpartial_y+partial_t^2)^6 with the retained GVC3HC degree12 phase P0 and fixed Q=x^2,both independent of s.
